prompts.title: Collector Specification Sheet
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE

You are an award-winning automotive creative director and editorial designer specializing in luxury automotive brochures, industrial design presentations, and museum-quality collector posters.

Your work combines the visual language of:

• Porsche Design Studio
• Apple Industrial Design
• Dieter Rams
• Braun
• Swiss Graphic Design
• Monocle Magazine
• Porsche Press Kits
• BMW Heritage Catalogs
• Mercedes-Benz Design Books
• Automotive Engineering Specification Sheets

The result must look like an official manufacturer design document—not an AI-generated poster.

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Design a premium automotive collector specification sheet.

NOT an advertisement.

NOT a movie poster.

NOT a social media graphic.

Instead create an official-looking concept vehicle presentation that could be printed inside a manufacturer's confidential design portfolio.

The design should feel timeless, restrained, luxurious, and extremely expensive.

--------------------------------------------------

# CANVAS

Orientation:
Portrait

Aspect Ratio:
4:5

Resolution:
8K

Print Ready

Ultra Sharp

Museum Quality

Perfect Typography

--------------------------------------------------

# VEHICLE

Car:
[CAR MODEL]

Brand:
[CAR BRAND]

Year:
[YEAR]

Color:
[CAR COLOR]

Body Style:
[BODY STYLE]

Preserve the exact proportions, body lines, wheels, headlights, grille, mirrors, windows, badges, and overall identity of the vehicle.

Ultra photorealistic.

No redesign.

No exaggerated proportions.

--------------------------------------------------

# MAIN IMAGE

Large hero render occupying approximately 55–60% of the page.

Three-quarter front view.

Low camera angle.

85mm lens.

Slight steering angle.

Studio photography.

Perfect reflections.

Luxury automotive lighting.

The vehicle should dominate the composition while maintaining generous negative space.

--------------------------------------------------

# BACKGROUND

Minimal off-white museum paper.

Warm white.

Very subtle texture.

Soft gradient only.

No scenery.

No roads.

No buildings.

No sky.

No environment.

No distracting graphics.

--------------------------------------------------

# LAYOUT

Strict Swiss Grid.

Everything perfectly aligned.

Large margins.

Consistent spacing.

Invisible baseline grid.

Professional editorial hierarchy.

Every section aligned precisely.

Nothing randomly placed.

--------------------------------------------------

# HEADER

Small brand name.

Large model name.

Large year.

Small "Concept" or "Vision" subtitle.

One short design philosophy sentence.

Example:

"The next chapter of electric performance."

--------------------------------------------------

# TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Create a professional engineering specification table.

Include:

Powertrain

Engine

Horsepower

Torque

Transmission

Drive Type

Battery Capacity

Range

Acceleration

Top Speed

Length

Width

Height

Wheelbase

Weight

Seats

Body Style

Platform

Use thin divider lines.

Perfect alignment.

Minimal typography.

--------------------------------------------------

# ENGINEERING DRAWINGS

Generate clean technical line drawings of the same vehicle.

Include:

Side View

Front View

Rear View

Top View

Dimension arrows.

Measurements.

Fine engineering lines.

Blueprint aesthetic.

Minimal grayscale.

--------------------------------------------------

# DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Create a short editorial paragraph describing:

• Design language
• Aerodynamics
• Performance philosophy
• Materials
• Driver experience

Professional automotive editorial tone.

Never sound like marketing.

--------------------------------------------------

# PERFORMANCE ICONS

Include minimal monochrome icons representing:

Performance

Precision

Electric

Aerodynamics

Innovation

Driver Focus

Lightweight

--------------------------------------------------

# SPECIMEN SECTION

Bottom-right corner.

Collector edition label.

Example:

Specimen

01 / 100

Limited Concept Series

Small barcode.

Internal reference number.

--------------------------------------------------

# FOOTER

Very small typography.

Examples:

Renault Design Center

Concept Vehicle

Internal Development Program

Confidential Prototype

Design Archive

Engineering Division

--------------------------------------------------

# TYPOGRAPHY

Swiss Sans Serif.

Large hierarchy.

Perfect kerning.

Perfect tracking.

Editorial spacing.

Modern typography.

Minimal.

Elegant.

No decorative fonts.

--------------------------------------------------

# COLOR PALETTE

95% monochrome.

White

Warm White

Black

Dark Grey

Light Grey

Allow only the actual vehicle color to remain.

Everything else should stay neutral.

--------------------------------------------------

# LIGHTING

Professional automotive studio.

Large softboxes.

HDR.

Soft reflections.

Controlled highlights.

Realistic metallic paint.

Detailed carbon fiber.

Detailed glass.

Detailed tires.

Detailed wheels.

Ray-traced reflections.

Physically accurate lighting.

--------------------------------------------------

# MATERIALS

Photorealistic.

No CGI appearance.

No illustration style.

Real aluminum.

Real carbon fiber.

Real rubber.

Real paint texture.

Real glass.

Microscopic surface detail.

--------------------------------------------------

# STYLE

Apple Design

Porsche Brochure

BMW Heritage

Mercedes-Benz Press Kit

Industrial Design Presentation

Swiss Graphic Design

Museum Exhibition Catalog

Automotive Design Portfolio

Luxury Print Publication

Confidential Engineering Documentation

--------------------------------------------------

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

No scenery

No roads

No mountains

No city

No people

No drivers

No motion blur

No smoke

No racing effects

No explosions

No colorful graphics

No visual clutter

No comic style

No cartoon

No painterly look

No CGI look

No unrealistic reflections

No exaggerated proportions

No incorrect wheels

No fake badges

No watermark

No signatures

No borders

No low-quality typography

No distorted perspective

No unnecessary decorative elements

--------------------------------------------------

# FINAL RESULT

The final image should look indistinguishable from an official confidential concept vehicle specification sheet created by Renault, Porsche, BMW, or Mercedes-Benz for internal design review.

It should feel collectible, museum-worthy, timeless, elegant, technically precise, and expensive enough to be framed in a luxury automotive design studio.

prompts.title: Macro Detail Series
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE

You are an award-winning automotive photographer, industrial designer, and luxury editorial art director specializing in macro automotive photography.

Your work combines:

• Leica Photography
• Hasselblad Editorial
• Apple Product Photography
• Porsche Design Studio
• Bugatti Design Books
• Pagani Detail Photography
• Swiss Editorial Design
• Luxury Watch Advertising

The goal is not to showcase the whole vehicle.

The goal is to celebrate craftsmanship.

Every image should make the viewer appreciate the engineering, materials, precision, and beauty of individual components.

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Create a premium "Macro Detail Series" collector poster.

The poster is composed of multiple ultra-close-up photographs of one vehicle.

Each photograph highlights a specific design element.

The collection should feel like a luxury design study rather than an advertisement.

Every crop must look intentional.

Every surface should communicate quality.

--------------------------------------------------

# CANVAS

Portrait

4:5

8K

Museum Quality

Print Ready

Ultra Sharp

--------------------------------------------------

# VEHICLE

Car:
[CAR MODEL]

Brand:
[CAR BRAND]

Year:
[YEAR]

Color:
[CAR COLOR]

Body Style:
[BODY STYLE]

Preserve the exact identity of the vehicle.

Do not redesign any components.

Maintain authentic materials, proportions, finishes, and branding.

--------------------------------------------------

# POSTER LAYOUT

Modern Swiss Grid.

Asymmetrical layout.

Large margins.

Consistent spacing.

Invisible grid.

Minimalist composition.

The poster consists of 7–10 macro photographs.

Different image sizes.

Clean geometric arrangement.

Editorial design.

--------------------------------------------------

# MACRO SHOTS

Capture ultra-close photographs of:

01 — Headlight Signature

02 — Front Grille

03 — Wheel & Brake Caliper

04 — Front Fender Surface

05 — Carbon Fiber Detail

06 — Side Mirror

11 — Start Button

12 — Dashboard Material

13 — Seat Stitching

14 — Badge / Emblem

15 — Charging Port or Fuel Cap

Choose the most beautiful details.

Each crop should emphasize texture, light, and precision.

--------------------------------------------------

# PHOTOGRAPHY

100mm Macro Lens

150mm Macro Lens

Studio Photography

HDR

ISO 100

f/11

Maximum Sharpness

Extreme Detail

No motion blur

No distortion

True-to-life perspective

--------------------------------------------------

# LIGHTING

Luxury studio lighting.

Large diffused softboxes.

Controlled reflections.

Beautiful highlights.

Deep shadows.

Natural contrast.

Reveal material textures.

Highlight:

• Brushed aluminum
• Carbon fiber
• Leather grain
• Alcantara
• Painted surfaces
• Glass
• Rubber
• Metal machining
• LED signatures

--------------------------------------------------

# MATERIAL QUALITY

Ultra Photorealistic.

Microscopic surface detail.

Visible paint texture.

Fine metallic flakes.

Real carbon fiber weave.

Natural leather pores.

Visible stitching.

Machined aluminum.

Brake rotor texture.

Tire sidewall details.

Glass reflections.

No CGI appearance.

--------------------------------------------------

# TYPOGRAPHY

Swiss Sans Serif.

Large model name.

Example:

RS VISION

2027

Below:

MACRO DETAIL SERIES

Minimal hierarchy.

Perfect alignment.

--------------------------------------------------

# LABELS

Each macro image includes a tiny caption.

Example:

01.

LIGHT SIGNATURE

02.

AERODYNAMIC SURFACE

03.

WHEEL DESIGN

04.

CARBON STRUCTURE

Minimal typography.

Tiny.

Professional.

--------------------------------------------------

# SPECIFICATIONS

Bottom section only.

Very small.

Powertrain

Horsepower

Torque

Transmission

Battery

Range

Dimensions

Nothing excessive.

--------------------------------------------------

# DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

One short paragraph.

Explain how every detail serves both beauty and engineering.

Write like an industrial design publication.

Not marketing.

--------------------------------------------------

# BACKGROUND

Warm museum paper.

#F6F4EF

Very subtle paper texture.

No scenery.

No environment.

No colorful graphics.

--------------------------------------------------

# COLOR PALETTE

Warm White

Charcoal

Light Grey

Black

Only the vehicle's original accent colors remain.

Everything else stays neutral.

--------------------------------------------------

# STYLE REFERENCES

Apple Design Book

Leica Editorial

Porsche Design Archive

Pagani Photography

Swiss Graphic Design

Museum Exhibition

Luxury Watch Catalog

Industrial Design Portfolio

Architecture Magazine

--------------------------------------------------

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

No full vehicle hero shot

No scenery

No roads

No city

No mountains

No people

No motion blur

No dramatic effects

No racing graphics

No colorful backgrounds

No fake reflections

No CGI appearance

No cartoon style

No painterly effects

No low-detail textures

No watermark

No borders

No signatures

The final image should resemble a premium collector's design board from the Porsche, Ferrari, Bugatti, or Pagani design studio.

Every macro photograph should feel like a fine-art print, revealing the craftsmanship, engineering precision, and material quality of the vehicle.

The viewer should appreciate the car without ever needing to see the entire vehicle.

prompts.title: Color Block

# ROLE

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Create a premium "Color Block" automotive poster.

Everything else must remain neutral.

The accent color becomes the visual identity of the entire poster.

Bauhaus

Detailed carbon fiber.

Detailed tires.

No CGI appearance.

--------------------------------------------------

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

No scenery

No roads

No city

No mountains

No racing graphics

No smoke

No speed effects

No excessive gradients

No colorful clutter

No multiple accent colors

No fake reflections

No CGI appearance

No cartoon style

No painterly effects

The finished poster should resemble a limited-edition collector's print from Porsche, Ferrari, Bugatti, or Lamborghini.

The viewer's eye should immediately recognize the single bold accent color as the visual identity of the composition.

prompts.title: Automotive Magazine Cover

Professional print quality.

Sharp geometry.

Large planes.

Strong symmetry.

Model name.

Year.

White

Black

Natural shadows

Audi Campaigns

Porsche Museum

Apple Design

Wallpaper*

Architectural Digest

Monocle

Swiss Grid

Luxury Editorial Design

Modern Architecture Photography

85mm Lens

Low Perspective

f/8

Detailed metallic paint.

Physically accurate lighting.

No CGI appearance.

No traffic

No city skyline

No mountains

No houses

No people

No trees

No racing effects

No smoke

No motion blur

No colorful graphics

No visual clutter

No fake reflections

No cartoon style

No painterly effects

No watermark

No signatures

No borders

────────────────────────────────────────

The final artwork should resemble an official Audi Sport campaign photographed inside a world-famous minimalist architectural masterpiece.

The viewer should feel that the architecture and the Audi RS8 share the same philosophy: precision, simplicity, engineering, and timeless design.

prompts.title: Neoclassical style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Neoclassical style.

Inspired by the grandeur of Ancient Greece and Rome, emphasize perfect symmetry, balance, proportion, and timeless elegance. Incorporate marble architecture, Corinthian and Ionic columns, decorative moldings, arches, pediments, sculptural reliefs, laurel wreaths, and geometric patterns where appropriate. Use luxurious materials such as polished white marble, limestone, bronze, brass, rich wood, and subtle gold accents. Apply a refined color palette of ivory, cream, warm beige, charcoal, muted gray, deep navy, emerald, and soft gold. The composition should feel prestigious, noble, harmonious, and timeless. Use soft natural lighting, exceptional craftsmanship, clean composition, intricate details, museum-quality aesthetics, cinematic realism, ultra-high detail, 8K.

prompts.title: Baroque style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Baroque style.

Inspired by the opulence and theatrical grandeur of 17th-century European Baroque art and architecture, emphasize dramatic movement, lavish ornamentation, rich textures, and emotional intensity. Incorporate elaborate scrollwork, gilded carvings, floral motifs, cherubs, ornate frames, grand arches, domes, fresco-inspired details, intricate reliefs, and luxurious decorative patterns where appropriate. Use premium materials such as polished marble, carved wood, velvet, silk, crystal, brass, bronze, and abundant gold leaf accents. Apply a rich color palette of deep crimson, royal blue, emerald green, burgundy, ivory, black, warm cream, and antique gold. Create strong contrasts between light and shadow (chiaroscuro), cinematic lighting, dynamic compositions, and a sense of grandeur and spectacle. Every element should feel handcrafted, luxurious, highly detailed, expressive, and majestic while maintaining visual harmony. Ultra-realistic, museum-quality craftsmanship, cinematic atmosphere, intricate detailing, premium luxury aesthetics, 8K, professional design.

Emphasize soft glowing light, atmospheric blur effects, translucent layers, ethereal wave patterns, floating shapes, and subtle glass-like surfaces where appropriate. Use a vibrant yet harmonious color palette of emerald green, cyan, turquoise, sapphire blue, violet, magenta, lavender, soft pink, and hints of white light. The composition should feel weightless, immersive, and continuously flowing, with smooth gradients and ambient lighting creating a magical sense of depth. Incorporate gentle bloom, diffused reflections, volumetric light, and delicate transparency while maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic. Every element should evoke wonder, serenity, innovation, and cosmic elegance. Ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, premium digital art, futuristic luxury, highly refined, 8K, professional quality.

Use premium materials such as frosted glass, sheer fabric, silk, pearlescent surfaces, soft matte finishes, and subtle crystalline reflections. Typography and decorative elements should be refined, minimal, and graceful, emphasizing elegance over complexity. Use oversized typography, thick black outlines, flat geometric shapes, rigid grid layouts, sharp corners, exaggerated buttons, simple illustrations, sticker-like graphics, bold icons, drop shadows, expressive labels, badges, speech bubbles, UI cards, and intentionally minimal decorative elements where appropriate. Favor functionality over polish while maintaining excellent usability and visual hierarchy. Incorporate modern digital materials such as flat solid colors, matte surfaces, vector graphics, crisp borders, paper-like textures, and simple geometric patterns without gradients or glass effects. Apply a vibrant high-contrast color palette using white, black, electric blue, bright yellow, hot pink, vivid orange, lime green, purple, cyan, red, and other saturated accent colors combined with generous white space. Typography should feature oversized bold sans-serif fonts, grotesque typefaces, condensed headlines, monospaced labels, and highly readable UI typography with strong visual hierarchy. Lighting should remain flat and graphic, using hard-edged shadows, offset drop shadows, bold outlines, and minimal depth instead of realistic lighting. The composition should feel energetic, honest, structured, playful, and unmistakably modern while remaining clean, accessible, and easy to navigate. Every detail should communicate confidence, simplicity, functionality, creativity, and digital-first design thinking. Ultra-detailed, premium UI aesthetics, award-winning contemporary graphic design, professional quality, 8K.

prompts.title: A Conversation Across Time
prompts.promptText:
Create a realistic emotional black-and-white portrait using the two uploaded reference photos only. Use the first uploaded photo as the child version of the same person (YEAR OF BIRTH) and the second uploaded photo as the adult version of the same person (CURRENT YEAR). Preserve facial identity accurately from both reference photos with maximum likeness, especially eyes, eyebrows, smile, face shape, beard, glasses, and hairline.
Scene composition: the child stands/sits on the left side looking warmly and curiously toward his future self. The adult sits on the right side, leaning forward with both hands under his chin, smiling gently while looking directly at the child. Both characters must clearly look at each other.
Between them is a table with a plaid tablecloth and a beautiful two-layer birthday cake. On top of the cake place large candle numbers “29”.
Style: nostalgic cinematic black-and-white photography, soft shadows, detailed skin texture, realistic lighting, emotional timeless atmosphere, clean background wall.
Top left area: bold white text “YEAR OF BIRTH” placed comfortably away from edges.
Top right area: bold white text “CURRENT YEAR” placed comfortably away from edges.
Important: faces must strongly resemble the uploaded references, not generic people. Child must look exactly like the child photo, adult must look exactly like the adult selfie. Highly realistic, sharp focus, premium composition, vertical portrait ratio 9:16.

howToUse.text: Replace [YEAR OF BIRTH] with yours, e.g. 1995, etc. and [CURRENT YEAR] with the current year, e.g. 2026, etc.

howToUse.text: Upload two pictures of yours, one as a kid and a most recent one.

prompts.title: Monochrome Prestige
prompts.promptText:
Transform the uploaded image into a premium luxury editorial portrait while preserving the subject's identity, pose, facial features, clothing, and composition exactly as they are.

Apply the following edits only:

• Remove the entire background and replace it with a perfectly clean, seamless pure white (#FFFFFF) studio backdrop.
• Convert the image into true monochrome (black and white), with deep blacks and pure whites. No gray color cast, sepia, or color tint.
• Increase overall sharpness, clarity, and micro-contrast while maintaining natural skin texture.
• Upscale the image to ultra-high resolution (8K quality) with maximum detail recovery.
• Enhance facial details, beard, hair strands, eyebrows, eyelashes, clothing fabric, and accessories without making them look artificial.
• Create a clean high-key studio look with soft professional lighting and bright whites.
• Add subtle edge separation (rim lighting) around the subject to cleanly separate them from the white background.
• Improve dynamic range while preserving realistic shadows.
• Remove digital noise, compression artifacts, blur, and unwanted distractions.
• Keep the image looking like it was captured with a professional full-frame camera using an 85mm portrait lens.
• Produce a premium fashion editorial finish with crisp details and natural textures.

Do NOT:
- Change the person's identity.
- Change facial proportions.
- Change hairstyle unless explicitly requested.
- Change beard or makeup.
- Change clothing.
- Change pose or camera angle.
- Add objects.
- Add text or logos.
- Over-smooth skin.
- Introduce AI artifacts.
- Cartoonize or stylize the image.
- Alter the original composition.

Goal:
A hyper-realistic, ultra-clean, professionally retouched, high-resolution black-and-white portrait with a pure white background, luxury editorial quality, maximum sharpness, and natural realism.

prompts.title: Monochrome Color Splash Portrait
prompts.promptText:
REFERENCE STYLE ONLY — APPLY THIS AS A FILTER / EDITING EFFECT TO THE INPUT IMAGE. DO NOT CHANGE THE SUBJECT'S IDENTITY, FACE, POSE, EXPRESSION, CAMERA ANGLE, HAIRSTYLE, CLOTHING, OR COMPOSITION.

OBJECTIVE:
Transform the uploaded image into a premium fine-art editorial portrait using a selective color splash effect. The edit must preserve the original photograph while dramatically enhancing it with artistic masking, monochrome treatment, and ink-splash styling.

EDITING INSTRUCTIONS:

• Remove the original background completely with an extremely accurate, hair-level cutout.
• Upscale the image to ultra-high resolution (8K quality) while preserving natural facial features, skin texture, beard strands, hair detail, clothing fabric, and eyewear.
• Sharpen intelligently without creating halos, oversharpening, or artificial edges.
• Reduce image noise while maintaining authentic skin pores and fine details.
• Improve micro-contrast and local contrast for a premium editorial finish.

BLACK & WHITE TREATMENT:
• Convert the ENTIRE image into true monochrome.
• Use deep cinematic blacks and clean neutral whites.
• No blue tint.
• No sepia.
• No warm or cool color cast.
• Rich tonal separation with dramatic but realistic contrast.
• Preserve smooth grayscale transitions.

SELECTIVE COLOR SPLASH:
Create an irregular organic splash-shaped mask centered on the subject.

Inside this splash:
• Reveal ONLY the original natural colors already present in the source image.
• Do NOT invent colors.
• Do NOT recolor anything.
• Simply reveal the subject's authentic colors exactly as they exist in the original photograph.
• Skin tones remain natural.
• Hair remains natural.
• Beard remains natural.
• Glasses retain their real colors and reflections.
• Clothing keeps its original color.
• Every visible object inside the splash remains true to the original photo.

Outside the splash:
• Everything stays completely black and white.
• Absolutely no color leakage.
• Perfect transition between colored and monochrome regions.

SPLASH DESIGN:
• The splash must be irregular and organic.
• Inspired by watercolor, ink explosion, acrylic paint, smoke, dust, and brush splatter.
• Soft feathered edges mixed with random paint droplets.
• Dynamic asymmetrical shape.
• No geometric circles.
• No perfect ellipse.
• No hard masking edges.
• The splash should naturally wrap around the subject.

BACKGROUND:
Replace the removed background with a clean pure white (#FFFFFF) canvas.

Around the subject:
• Add expressive monochrome watercolor splashes.
• Black ink bursts.
• Gray paint textures.
• Charcoal dust.
• Fine paint speckles.
• Abstract brush strokes.
• Soft smoke textures.
• Layered ink clouds.
• High-end contemporary fine-art composition.

These artistic elements must remain BLACK & WHITE ONLY and never introduce color.

LIGHTING:
• Preserve original lighting direction.
• Enhance dynamic range.
• Bright but realistic highlights.
• Rich shadows.
• Premium studio-quality tonal depth.
• Editorial fashion lighting.
• Soft natural falloff.

QUALITY:
• Ultra-clean masking.
• No artifacts.
• No jagged edges.
• No AI distortions.
• No duplicated features.
• No warped anatomy.
• Preserve every facial proportion exactly.
• Maintain original framing unless slight cropping improves composition.
• Professional gallery-quality finish.
• Luxury editorial aesthetic.
• Museum-grade print quality.

prompts.title: Minimalism En
prompts.promptText:
Create a premium commercial FITNESS / NUTRITION advertisement using a STRICT, SOPHISTICATED, HIGH-END MINIMALIST DESIGN STYLE.

The final artwork must be designed specifically for an ENGLISH-SPEAKING AUDIENCE.

English must be the PRIMARY visual language of the final advertisement.

The entire composition must follow a natural LEFT-TO-RIGHT (LTR) visual and typographic flow.

The final artwork must look like it was created by an elite commercial art director, premium fitness brand designer, professional product photographer, and high-end minimalist graphic designer working together.

The result must feel:

MINIMAL.
PREMIUM.
CLEAN.
ELEGANT.
MODERN.
REFINED.
CONFIDENT.
CALM.
COMMERCIAL.
TIMELESS.
EASY ON THE EYES.

This is NOT a generic "minimal design" poster.

Do NOT simply place a product on a blank background and add text.

Create a genuine, professionally art-directed minimalist composition where every element, proportion, margin, alignment, and visual relationship has a deliberate purpose.

The PRODUCT remains the HERO.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. PRODUCT INPUT
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRODUCT IMAGE:

[INSERT PRODUCT IMAGE]

The uploaded product image is the PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH.

The image must be analyzed before creating the advertisement.

Do NOT require the user to manually provide product information if it can be reliably extracted from the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. PRODUCT IMAGE ANALYSIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before designing the advertisement, carefully inspect the uploaded product image.

Identify and extract ONLY information that is clearly visible and reliably readable from the product packaging.

Analyze:

• Product name
• Product type
• Brand name
• Flavor
• Net weight
• Serving size
• Protein amount per serving
• Calories per serving
• Protein percentage
• Carbohydrates
• Fat
• Ingredients
• Key nutritional information
• Product features
• Product claims
• Certifications
• Any other clearly printed product information

The uploaded packaging is the authoritative source.

Do NOT invent, assume, estimate, infer, or fabricate product information.

If information is partially visible but cannot be read with confidence, DO NOT use it.

If information is completely absent from the image, DO NOT create it.

If nutritional information is visible, preserve the exact values and units shown on the packaging.

Do not convert, reinterpret, round, or modify numerical values unless explicitly requested.

For example:

If the package says "27g Protein", use:

"27g Protein"

If it says "109 kcal", use:

"109 kcal"

If it says "1 KG", use:

"1 KG"

Do not change these factual values.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. INFORMATION SELECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After analyzing the product image, automatically determine which extracted information is most valuable for a premium minimalist commercial advertisement.

Prioritize:

1. Product name
2. Brand name
3. Most important nutritional value
4. Key product specification
5. Net weight
6. Flavor, if relevant
7. One or two important product features

Do NOT attempt to display every piece of information extracted from the packaging.

This is a PREMIUM ADVERTISEMENT, not a nutrition facts sheet.

Select only the information that improves the advertisement.

Use concise visual callouts instead of paragraphs.

For example, if clearly visible on the package, information such as:

27g Protein
109 kcal
86% Protein
1 KG

may be presented as elegant visual highlights.

Only use these values if they are actually visible and readable in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. PRODUCT TITLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically determine the product title from the uploaded packaging.

Use the exact recognizable product name printed on the package whenever possible.

Do NOT invent a new product name.

Do NOT rewrite the brand or product name unnecessarily.

If the product title is clearly written in English, preserve it accurately.

If the product title contains a generic descriptive phrase that can be naturally presented in English, use the clearest recognizable wording.

If the product title is unclear, use only the clearly readable portion.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. BRAND IDENTIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically identify the brand from the packaging if clearly visible.

Preserve the original logo and brand identity.

Do NOT redesign the logo.

Do NOT recreate a fake logo.

Do NOT invent brand elements.

The brand should remain visually consistent with the original packaging.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. PRODUCT PRESERVATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the provided product image as the PRIMARY VISUAL SOURCE.

The product is the central visual hero of the entire composition.

Do NOT unnecessarily redesign, deform, replace, recolor, or alter the product packaging.

Preserve:

• exact product shape
• packaging structure
• logo
• brand identity
• printed typography
• label details
• proportions
• colors
• recognizable characteristics
• material appearance

The product must remain immediately recognizable as the exact original product.

If the provided image contains multiple products, preserve the correct number of products.

Do not duplicate products unnecessarily.

Do not generate additional flavors, variants, containers, packages, or accessories unless they are visibly present in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. TEXT GENERATION RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The advertisement may use TWO primary sources of text:

SOURCE A — USER-PROVIDED TEXT

If the user explicitly provides promotional text, CTA, price, offer, slogan, or campaign message, it may be incorporated into the design.

SOURCE B — PRODUCT-PACKAGING INFORMATION

The AI may extract factual product information directly from the uploaded packaging.

This includes clearly readable:

• Product name
• Brand name
• Nutritional values
• Product specifications
• Flavor
• Weight
• Product features
• Printed claims

ONLY use information that is clearly supported by the uploaded image or explicitly provided by the user.

All newly generated marketing text must be written in NATURAL, PROFESSIONAL ENGLISH.

The copy must feel premium, concise, modern, and commercially appropriate.

Do NOT invent:

• nutritional facts
• ingredients
• calories
• protein percentages
• health claims
• medical claims
• prices
• discounts
• certifications
• awards
• statistics
• testimonials
• product specifications
• performance claims

Do not create marketing claims that are not supported by the packaging or user-provided information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
8. FACTUAL ACCURACY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This is CRITICAL.

Every factual product statement in the advertisement must be traceable to either:

1. The uploaded product packaging

OR

2. Information explicitly provided by the user.

Never fill missing information with assumptions.

Never use generic supplement statistics.

Never invent benefits simply because the product belongs to a particular category.

For example:

Do NOT automatically claim:

"Builds muscle"

"Burns fat"

"Boosts testosterone"

"Improves recovery"

"Clinically proven"

"100% pure"

"Zero sugar"

"High absorption"

unless the claim is explicitly visible on the packaging or explicitly provided by the user.

Accuracy is more important than adding more text.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
9. LANGUAGE HANDLING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The FINAL ADVERTISEMENT must be ENGLISH-FIRST.

All newly generated:

• headlines
• subtitles
• promotional messages
• CTAs
• supporting text
• product information callouts
• descriptive text

must be written in professional English.

Use NATURAL MODERN ENGLISH suitable for commercial fitness and nutrition advertising.

Use correct:

• spelling
• grammar
• punctuation
• capitalization
• typography
• LTR direction
• text hierarchy

Do NOT generate pseudo-English text.

Do NOT generate meaningless text.

Do NOT reverse text.

Do NOT mirror letters incorrectly.

All English text must read naturally from LEFT TO RIGHT.

The visual composition must also respect LTR reading flow.

Do NOT introduce unnecessary bilingual text.

English should remain the dominant language throughout the advertisement.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
10. MINIMALIST COPY STYLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use short, sophisticated, premium English advertising language.

The copy should feel:

• modern
• confident
• concise
• natural
• professional
• premium
• performance-oriented

Avoid:

• cheap advertising language
• exaggerated claims
• long sentences
• unnecessary slogans
• excessive punctuation
• excessive exclamation marks
• generic motivational clichés

Prefer concise commercial language.

Examples of STYLE only:

"Built for Performance"

"Power Your Performance"

"Performance Starts Here"

"Made for Your Next Level"

"Precision in Every Serving"

These are examples of tone and structure only.

Do NOT automatically use these phrases unless they are appropriate to the specific product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
11. CORE MINIMALISM DIRECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a sophisticated PREMIUM MINIMALIST visual system.

Minimalism must be treated as a complete art-direction philosophy, not simply an absence of decoration.

Use:

• generous negative space
• precise alignment
• restrained color
• controlled typography
• strong hierarchy
• clean geometry
• intentional proportions
• subtle depth
• refined spacing
• visual simplicity

Every element must have a purpose.

The design should communicate luxury through restraint.

Do not add visual elements simply because there is empty space.

Empty space is an intentional design element.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
12. PRODUCT PRIORITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The product MUST remain more visually important than every other element.

The product is the visual anchor.

The product must remain:

• sharp
• recognizable
• readable
• visually dominant
• physically grounded

Do not cover important product details with typography.

Do not place unnecessary decorative elements around the product.

Do not allow text to overpower the product.

The entire composition should support the product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
13. VISUAL HIERARCHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Establish a strict visual hierarchy:

1. PRODUCT
2. PRODUCT TITLE / PRIMARY MESSAGE
3. KEY PRODUCT INFORMATION
4. BRAND
5. SUPPORTING INFORMATION
6. CTA, if provided

The product must immediately attract attention.

Typography must remain secondary to the product.

Supporting information must remain subtle.

Decorative elements, if any, must remain almost invisible.

The viewer should understand the advertisement within approximately one second.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
14. BACKGROUND
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create an extremely clean, sophisticated background.

Prefer:

• pure white
• soft off-white
• warm cream
• light gray
• refined charcoal
• deep black
• subtle brand-colored background

Choose the background according to the product packaging and brand identity.

The background must remain visually quiet.

Avoid complicated scenery.

Avoid realistic gyms unless explicitly requested.

Avoid unnecessary environments.

Avoid decorative backgrounds.

Avoid excessive gradients.

If a gradient is used, it must be extremely subtle.

The background should create contrast and breathing room for the product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
15. PRODUCT PRESENTATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Treat the product as a premium commercial product-photography subject.

Present it with:

• precise positioning
• realistic scale
• realistic perspective
• controlled lighting
• clean surroundings
• subtle contact shadow
• professional visual separation

The product may be:

• centered
• slightly off-center
• aligned to a grid
• positioned using the rule of thirds
• placed within a strong editorial composition

Choose the strongest placement automatically.

Do not follow a rigid template.

The product must feel intentionally staged.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16. LIGHTING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium commercial studio lighting.

Lighting should be:

• soft
• realistic
• controlled
• dimensional
• elegant
• natural

Use subtle highlights to reveal the product's shape and material.

Use realistic contact shadows.

Use soft cast shadows when appropriate.

Avoid:

• excessive rim lighting
• neon outlines
• artificial glow
• extreme bloom
• unrealistic reflections
• overexposure
• harsh shadows
• dramatic cinematic effects

Minimalist lighting should feel quiet and expensive.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
17. DEPTH AND DIMENSION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Minimalism does NOT mean completely flat.

Create subtle depth through:

• realistic contact shadows
• controlled highlights
• tonal separation
• subtle perspective
• realistic surface interaction
• restrained background separation

Depth should remain subtle.

Do not create unnecessary 3D effects.

Do not make the design look like a CGI poster.

The viewer should feel physical quality without being distracted by visual effects.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
18. COLOR SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Build the color system around the actual product packaging.

Extract the dominant visual colors from the product.

Use a highly restrained palette.

Prefer:

• one dominant background tone
• product colors
• one neutral supporting color
• one subtle accent

Do not introduce unrelated colors.

If the product packaging is highly colorful, simplify the surrounding environment.

The product should provide most of the visual color.

The background must never compete with the product.

Maintain excellent contrast and visual harmony.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
19. INFORMATION CALLOUTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When reliable nutritional or product information has been extracted from the packaging, present only the most important values as elegant minimalist callouts.

Examples:

27g PROTEIN

109 KCAL

86% PROTEIN

1 KG

These are ONLY examples of formatting.

Do not automatically use these numbers unless they are actually visible on the uploaded product packaging.

Use:

• clean typography
• subtle dividers
• restrained spacing
• minimal icons only when truly necessary
• simple alignment
• strong hierarchy

Do not turn the advertisement into an infographic.

Do not create large statistic cards.

Do not display too many numbers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
20. DISTRACTION CONTROL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THIS IS CRITICAL.

The advertisement must be extremely easy on the eyes.

Minimalism is about eliminating everything unnecessary.

DO NOT add:

• random dumbbells
• random barbells
• random gym machines
• random weights
• bodybuilding silhouettes
• unrelated athletes
• random fruits
• random ingredients
• floating objects
• excessive particles
• smoke
• fire
• explosions
• lightning
• energy streaks
• neon effects
• excessive gradients
• decorative geometric shapes
• meaningless patterns
• excessive icons
• unnecessary badges
• excessive shadows
• excessive reflections
• fake statistics
• fake claims
• fake certifications
• visual clutter

Do not add decorative elements merely to make the image "more interesting."

If an element does not improve the product presentation, REMOVE IT.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
21. TYPOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium modern English typography.

Typography should be:

• clean
• minimal
• sophisticated
• highly readable
• balanced
• contemporary

Use no more than TWO typefaces.

Prefer:

• modern sans-serif
• neo-grotesk
• geometric sans-serif
• clean editorial typography

Use a restrained typographic hierarchy.

Use:

• clear font weights
• generous line height
• intentional letter spacing
• strong contrast
• precise alignment
• consistent spacing

All typography must follow LEFT-TO-RIGHT (LTR) reading direction.

Do NOT use:

• decorative fonts
• childish fonts
• overly futuristic fonts
• excessive boldness
• excessive outlines
• glowing text
• metallic text
• excessive shadows
• unnecessary text effects

Typography must feel like part of the architecture of the composition.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
22. TEXT DENSITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Keep the amount of text LOW.

This is a premium commercial advertisement, NOT a product catalog, nutrition label, or flyer.

Do not copy the entire back label into the design.

Do not display every ingredient or nutritional value.

Select only the strongest, most useful information.

Prioritize:

• visual impact
• immediate comprehension
• product recognition
• readability
• premium presentation

Use short labels and concise information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
23. FITNESS / NUTRITION VISUAL LANGUAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Communicate fitness through sophistication rather than clichés.

Possible concepts:

• performance
• athletic precision
• strength
• discipline
• clean energy
• wellness
• recovery
• healthy lifestyle
• premium sports culture

The design should communicate these concepts primarily through:

• composition
• product presentation
• typography
• lighting
• scale
• spacing
• color

Do not automatically add gym equipment.

Do not automatically add athletes.

Do not use bodybuilding clichés unless explicitly requested.

The product itself should communicate the fitness or nutrition category whenever possible.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
24. NEGATIVE SPACE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Negative space is one of the MOST IMPORTANT elements of the design.

Use generous breathing room.

Negative space should:

• isolate the product
• improve readability
• strengthen hierarchy
• reduce visual fatigue
• create elegance
• communicate premium quality

Do not fill empty areas simply because they exist.

Empty space is part of the composition.

The design should breathe.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
25. COMPOSITION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use professional minimalist graphic-design principles.

Possible approaches:

• centered hero
• asymmetric editorial layout
• rule-of-thirds
• strong vertical alignment
• controlled horizontal alignment
• grid-based composition
• large negative-space composition
• product-led editorial composition

Choose the strongest composition automatically based on the product image and extracted information.

Do not mechanically follow a template.

Use optical balance rather than rigid mathematical symmetry.

Every element must feel intentionally positioned.

The entire composition must follow a natural LEFT-TO-RIGHT visual flow.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
26. GRID AND ALIGNMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use an invisible professional grid.

Maintain:

• consistent margins
• consistent spacing
• alignment between text elements
• proportional relationships
• disciplined placement
• visual rhythm

Text, product, logo, and information callouts should feel connected through alignment.

Avoid randomly positioned elements.

Do not create excessive columns.

Keep the structure simple.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
27. BRANDING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If a brand name or logo is clearly visible on the product:

Integrate it subtly and professionally.

Do not overpower the product.

Do not redesign the logo.

Do not recreate a fake logo.

Do not invent brand elements.

Maintain visual consistency with the original packaging.

The brand should feel like part of the composition rather than an additional sticker.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
28. PREMIUM COMMERCIAL QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The final advertisement should feel suitable for:

• premium sports nutrition brands
• luxury fitness brands
• modern wellness companies
• high-end supplement companies
• athletic lifestyle brands
• professional commercial campaigns
• premium Instagram advertising

Think:

LUXURY FITNESS BRANDING

*

PREMIUM SPORTS NUTRITION

*

MINIMALIST ART DIRECTION

*

COMMERCIAL PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY

*

EDITORIAL GRAPHIC DESIGN

Do NOT make it look like:

• a generic AI poster
• a cheap supplement advertisement
• a gym flyer
• a bodybuilding poster
• a YouTube thumbnail
• a gaming poster
• a crowded Instagram template
• a generic Canva design

The design should feel timeless rather than trendy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
29. IMAGE QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Prioritize extremely high visual quality.

The final artwork must have:

• photorealistic product presentation
• accurate packaging
• realistic materials
• realistic lighting
• realistic shadows
• clean edges
• sharp product details
• natural depth
• professional color grading
• premium art direction
• polished English typography
• commercial-quality finish

Avoid:

• warped packaging
• distorted logos
• duplicated products
• malformed objects
• unreadable text
• incorrect typography
• random decorative elements
• unnatural shadows
• unrealistic materials
• inconsistent perspective
• AI artifacts
• invented product information

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
30. FINAL ART-DIRECTION CHECK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before finalizing the artwork, evaluate it as a professional minimalist commercial art director.

Ask:

Is the product immediately recognizable?

Is the product the strongest visual element?

Did the product analysis use only information actually visible in the uploaded image?

Are all nutritional values and specifications accurate?

Did the design avoid invented claims?

Is all newly generated text in natural, correct English?

Does the typography follow proper LTR composition?

Is the composition visually balanced?

Is there enough negative space?

Does the design feel genuinely minimalist?

Is anything unnecessary?

Is the background too complicated?

Are there too many decorative elements?

Does the product feel premium?

Does the lighting feel realistic?

Does the design feel expensive?

Does it look professionally art-directed?

Would a real premium fitness or nutrition brand publish this?

If removing an element makes the composition stronger, REMOVE IT.

The final design must feel:

MINIMAL.
PREMIUM.
CLEAN.
MODERN.
ELEGANT.
REFINED.
CONFIDENT.
TIMELESS.
BALANCED.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.

The goal is NOT to demonstrate how many design elements can be added.

The goal is to make the product look so refined that the simplicity itself becomes the luxury.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
31. FINAL OUTPUT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Generate ONE finished advertisement.

Do not generate multiple variations.

Do not show sketches.

Do not show wireframes.

Do not provide explanations.

Analyze the uploaded product image first.

Extract the reliable product information.

Select the most valuable information.

Determine the appropriate English copy.

Design the composition using the specified Minimalist art direction.

Then generate the final polished commercial artwork directly.

The final visible advertisement should be primarily English and follow a strict LTR visual structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
32. ASPECT RATIO — CHANGE ONLY THIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FINAL ASPECT RATIO:

9:16 VERTICAL PORTRAIT

Design the entire composition specifically for this aspect ratio from the beginning.

Do NOT create another aspect ratio and crop it afterward.

Do NOT stretch, squeeze, or distort the composition.

All visual elements must be intentionally positioned for the specified vertical format.

Maintain safe margins around the product, English typography, logo, nutritional callouts, and all important elements.

The final artwork must be a true 9:16 vertical composition optimized for Instagram Stories, Reels, and vertical social-media presentation.

prompts.title: Minimalism Ar
prompts.promptText:
Create a premium commercial FITNESS / NUTRITION advertisement using a STRICT, SOPHISTICATED, HIGH-END MINIMALIST DESIGN STYLE.

The final artwork must be designed specifically for an ARABIC-SPEAKING AUDIENCE.

Arabic must be the PRIMARY visual language of the final advertisement.

The entire composition must follow a natural RIGHT-TO-LEFT (RTL) visual and typographic flow.

The final artwork must look like it was created by an elite commercial art director, premium fitness brand designer, professional product photographer, Arabic typography specialist, and high-end minimalist graphic designer working together.

The result must feel:

MINIMAL.
PREMIUM.
CLEAN.
ELEGANT.
MODERN.
REFINED.
CONFIDENT.
CALM.
TIMELESS.
COMMERCIAL.
ARABIC-FIRST.
EASY ON THE EYES.

This is NOT a generic "minimal design" poster.

Do NOT simply place a product on a blank background and add text.

Create a genuine, professionally art-directed minimalist composition where every element, proportion, margin, alignment, spacing, and visual relationship has a deliberate purpose.

The PRODUCT remains the HERO.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. PRODUCT INPUT
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRODUCT IMAGE:

[INSERT PRODUCT IMAGE]

The uploaded product image is the PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH.

The image must be analyzed before creating the advertisement.

Do NOT require the user to manually provide product information if it can be reliably extracted from the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. PRODUCT IMAGE ANALYSIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before designing the advertisement, carefully inspect the uploaded product image.

Identify and extract ONLY information that is clearly visible and reliably readable from the product packaging.

Analyze:

• اسم المنتج
• نوع المنتج
• اسم العلامة التجارية
• النكهة
• الوزن الصافي
• حجم الحصة
• كمية البروتين في الحصة
• السعرات الحرارية في الحصة
• نسبة البروتين
• الكربوهيدرات
• الدهون
• المكونات
• المعلومات الغذائية الأساسية
• خصائص المنتج
• ادعاءات المنتج
• الشهادات
• أي معلومات أخرى مطبوعة بوضوح على العبوة

The uploaded packaging is the authoritative source.

Do NOT invent, assume, estimate, infer, or fabricate product information.

If information is partially visible but cannot be read with confidence, DO NOT use it.

If information is completely absent from the image, DO NOT create it.

If nutritional information is visible, preserve the exact factual values and units shown on the packaging.

Do not convert, reinterpret, round, or modify numerical values unless explicitly requested.

For example:

If the package says:

"27g Protein"

the Arabic advertisement may present it as:

"27 غ بروتين"

If it says:

"109 kcal"

it may be presented as:

"109 سعرة حرارية"

If it says:

"1 KG"

it may be presented as:

"1 كغ"

The factual numerical value must remain unchanged.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. INFORMATION SELECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After analyzing the product image, automatically determine which extracted information is most valuable for a premium minimalist commercial advertisement.

Prioritize:

1. اسم المنتج
2. اسم العلامة التجارية
3. أهم قيمة غذائية
4. أهم مواصفة للمنتج
5. الوزن الصافي
6. النكهة، إذا كانت مهمة
7. خاصية أو خاصيتان مهمتان للمنتج

Do NOT attempt to display every piece of information extracted from the packaging.

This is a PREMIUM ADVERTISEMENT, not a nutrition facts sheet.

Select only the information that improves the advertisement.

Use concise Arabic visual callouts instead of paragraphs.

For example, if clearly visible on the package:

27g Protein
109 kcal
86% Protein
1 KG

may be presented as:

27 غ بروتين
109 سعرة حرارية
86% بروتين
1 كغ

Only use these values if they are actually visible and readable in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. PRODUCT TITLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically determine the product title from the uploaded packaging.

Use the exact recognizable product name printed on the package whenever possible.

Do NOT invent a new product name.

Do NOT unnecessarily rewrite the brand or product name.

If the official product name is in English or another language, preserve the official product name when appropriate.

If a generic descriptive phrase can be naturally translated into Arabic without changing the product identity, translate it professionally.

Do NOT translate official brand names.

If the product title is unclear, use only the clearly readable portion.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. BRAND IDENTIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically identify the brand from the packaging if clearly visible.

Preserve the original logo and brand identity.

Do NOT redesign the logo.

Do NOT recreate a fake logo.

Do NOT invent brand elements.

Do NOT translate the official brand name unless explicitly requested.

The brand should remain visually consistent with the original packaging.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. PRODUCT PRESERVATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the provided product image as the PRIMARY VISUAL SOURCE.

The product is the central visual hero of the entire composition.

Do NOT unnecessarily redesign, deform, replace, recolor, or alter the product packaging.

Preserve:

• exact product shape
• packaging structure
• logo
• brand identity
• printed typography
• label details
• proportions
• colors
• recognizable characteristics
• material appearance

The product must remain immediately recognizable as the exact original product.

If the provided image contains multiple products, preserve the correct number of products.

Do not duplicate products unnecessarily.

Do not generate additional flavors, variants, containers, packages, or accessories unless they are visibly present in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. TEXT GENERATION RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The advertisement may use TWO primary sources of text:

SOURCE A — USER-PROVIDED TEXT

If the user explicitly provides promotional text, CTA, price, offer, slogan, or campaign message, it may be incorporated into the design.

If the user-provided promotional text is in English but the final advertisement is intended for an Arabic-speaking audience, translate it naturally into professional Arabic unless the user explicitly requests English.

SOURCE B — PRODUCT-PACKAGING INFORMATION

The AI may extract factual product information directly from the uploaded packaging.

This includes clearly readable:

• اسم المنتج
• اسم العلامة التجارية
• القيم الغذائية
• مواصفات المنتج
• النكهة
• الوزن
• خصائص المنتج
• الادعاءات المطبوعة

ONLY use information that is clearly supported by the uploaded image or explicitly provided by the user.

All newly generated marketing text must be written in NATURAL, PROFESSIONAL, CORRECT ARABIC.

The copy must feel premium, concise, modern, and commercially appropriate.

Do NOT invent:

• nutritional facts
• ingredients
• calories
• protein percentages
• health claims
• medical claims
• prices
• discounts
• certifications
• awards
• statistics
• testimonials
• product specifications
• performance claims

Do not create marketing claims that are not supported by the packaging or user-provided information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
8. FACTUAL ACCURACY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This is CRITICAL.

Every factual product statement in the advertisement must be traceable to either:

1. The uploaded product packaging

OR

2. Information explicitly provided by the user.

Never fill missing information with assumptions.

Never use generic supplement statistics.

Never invent benefits simply because the product belongs to a particular category.

For example:

Do NOT automatically claim:

"يساعد على بناء العضلات"

"يحرق الدهون"

"يعزز هرمون التستوستيرون"

"يحسن الاستشفاء"

"مثبت سريريًا"

"نقي 100%"

"خالي من السكر"

"امتصاص سريع"

unless the claim is explicitly visible on the packaging or explicitly provided by the user.

Accuracy is more important than adding more text.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
9. LANGUAGE HANDLING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The FINAL ADVERTISEMENT must be ARABIC-FIRST.

All newly generated:

• headlines
• subtitles
• promotional messages
• CTAs
• supporting text
• product information callouts
• descriptive text

must be written in professional Arabic.

Use NATURAL MODERN ARABIC suitable for commercial fitness and nutrition advertising.

Use correct:

• spelling
• grammar
• punctuation
• Arabic typography
• RTL direction
• text hierarchy
• Arabic letter connections

Do NOT generate pseudo-Arabic text.

Do NOT generate meaningless Arabic-like text.

Do NOT reverse Arabic text.

Do NOT mirror Arabic letters incorrectly.

All Arabic text must read naturally from RIGHT TO LEFT.

The visual composition must also respect RTL reading flow.

The viewer's eye should naturally move through the design according to Arabic visual reading direction.

Do NOT introduce unnecessary bilingual text.

English should only remain when it is part of:

• the original product packaging
• the official brand identity
• the official product name
• a user-provided element that the user explicitly wants preserved

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
10. ARABIC COPY STYLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use short, sophisticated, premium Arabic advertising language.

The copy should feel:

• modern
• confident
• concise
• natural
• professional
• premium
• performance-oriented

Avoid:

• cheap advertising language
• exaggerated claims
• long sentences
• unnecessary slogans
• excessive punctuation
• excessive exclamation marks
• generic motivational clichés

Prefer concise commercial Arabic.

Examples of STYLE only:

"أداء أقوى يبدأ من هنا"

"طاقة تدعم أداءك"

"اختيارك للأداء الأفضل"

"مصمم لأداءك اليومي"

"قوة في كل جرعة"

These are examples of tone and structure only.

Do NOT automatically use these phrases unless they are appropriate to the specific product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
11. CORE MINIMALISM DIRECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a sophisticated PREMIUM MINIMALIST visual system.

Minimalism must be treated as a complete art-direction philosophy, not simply an absence of decoration.

Use:

• generous negative space
• precise alignment
• restrained color
• controlled typography
• strong hierarchy
• clean geometry
• intentional proportions
• subtle depth
• refined spacing
• visual simplicity

Every element must have a purpose.

The design should communicate luxury through restraint.

Do not add visual elements simply because there is empty space.

Empty space is an intentional design element.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
12. PRODUCT PRIORITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The product MUST remain more visually important than every other element.

The product is the visual anchor.

The product must remain:

• sharp
• recognizable
• readable
• visually dominant
• physically grounded

Do not cover important product details with Arabic typography.

Do not place unnecessary decorative elements around the product.

Do not allow text to overpower the product.

The entire composition should support the product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
13. VISUAL HIERARCHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Establish a strict visual hierarchy:

1. PRODUCT
2. ARABIC PRODUCT TITLE / PRIMARY MESSAGE
3. KEY PRODUCT INFORMATION
4. BRAND
5. SUPPORTING INFORMATION
6. CTA, if provided

The product must immediately attract attention.

Arabic typography must remain secondary to the product.

Supporting information must remain subtle.

Decorative elements, if any, must remain almost invisible.

The viewer should understand the advertisement within approximately one second.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
14. BACKGROUND
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create an extremely clean, sophisticated background.

Prefer:

• pure white
• soft off-white
• warm cream
• light gray
• refined charcoal
• deep black
• subtle brand-colored background

Choose the background according to the product packaging and brand identity.

The background must remain visually quiet.

Avoid complicated scenery.

Avoid realistic gyms unless explicitly requested.

Avoid unnecessary environments.

Avoid decorative backgrounds.

Avoid excessive gradients.

If a gradient is used, it must be extremely subtle.

The background should create contrast and breathing room for the product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
15. PRODUCT PRESENTATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Treat the product as a premium commercial product-photography subject.

Present it with:

• precise positioning
• realistic scale
• realistic perspective
• controlled lighting
• clean surroundings
• subtle contact shadow
• professional visual separation

The product may be:

• centered
• slightly off-center
• aligned to a grid
• positioned using the rule of thirds
• placed within a strong editorial composition

Choose the strongest placement automatically.

Do not follow a rigid template.

The product must feel intentionally staged.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16. LIGHTING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium commercial studio lighting.

Lighting should be:

• soft
• realistic
• controlled
• dimensional
• elegant
• natural

Use subtle highlights to reveal the product's shape and material.

Use realistic contact shadows.

Use soft cast shadows when appropriate.

Avoid:

• excessive rim lighting
• neon outlines
• artificial glow
• extreme bloom
• unrealistic reflections
• overexposure
• harsh shadows
• dramatic cinematic effects

Minimalist lighting should feel quiet and expensive.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
17. DEPTH AND DIMENSION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Minimalism does NOT mean completely flat.

Create subtle depth through:

• realistic contact shadows
• controlled highlights
• tonal separation
• subtle perspective
• realistic surface interaction
• restrained background separation

Depth should remain subtle.

Do not create unnecessary 3D effects.

Do not make the design look like a CGI poster.

The viewer should feel physical quality without being distracted by visual effects.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
18. COLOR SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Build the color system around the actual product packaging.

Extract the dominant visual colors from the product.

Use a highly restrained palette.

Prefer:

• one dominant background tone
• product colors
• one neutral supporting color
• one subtle accent

Do not introduce unrelated colors.

If the product packaging is highly colorful, simplify the surrounding environment.

The product should provide most of the visual color.

The background must never compete with the product.

Maintain excellent contrast and visual harmony.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
19. INFORMATION CALLOUTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When reliable nutritional or product information has been extracted from the packaging, present only the most important values as elegant minimalist Arabic callouts.

Examples:

27 غ بروتين

109 سعرة حرارية

86% بروتين

1 كغ

These are ONLY examples of formatting.

Do not automatically use these numbers unless they are actually visible on the uploaded product packaging.

Use:

• clean Arabic typography
• subtle dividers
• restrained spacing
• minimal icons only when truly necessary
• simple alignment
• strong hierarchy

Do not turn the advertisement into an infographic.

Do not create large statistic cards.

Do not display too many numbers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
20. DISTRACTION CONTROL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THIS IS CRITICAL.

The advertisement must be extremely easy on the eyes.

Minimalism is about eliminating everything unnecessary.

DO NOT add:

• random dumbbells
• random barbells
• random gym machines
• random weights
• bodybuilding silhouettes
• unrelated athletes
• random fruits
• random ingredients
• floating objects
• excessive particles
• smoke
• fire
• explosions
• lightning
• energy streaks
• neon effects
• excessive gradients
• decorative geometric shapes
• meaningless patterns
• excessive icons
• unnecessary badges
• excessive shadows
• excessive reflections
• fake statistics
• fake claims
• fake certifications
• visual clutter

Do not add decorative elements merely to make the image "more interesting."

If an element does not improve the product presentation, REMOVE IT.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
21. ARABIC TYPOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium modern Arabic typography.

Typography should be:

• clean
• minimal
• sophisticated
• highly readable
• balanced
• contemporary

Prefer professional Arabic sans-serif typography such as:

• Cairo
• IBM Plex Sans Arabic
• DIN Next Arabic style
• modern geometric Arabic sans-serif
• clean contemporary Arabic typography

Use no more than TWO typefaces.

Typography must follow proper RIGHT-TO-LEFT direction.

Use:

• appropriate Arabic font weight
• comfortable line height
• balanced spacing
• proper RTL alignment
• strong contrast
• clear hierarchy
• generous breathing room

Do NOT use:

• decorative Arabic fonts
• childish fonts
• excessive calligraphy
• distorted Arabic letters
• incorrect letter connections
• reversed text
• excessive outlines
• glowing Arabic text
• metallic Arabic text
• excessive text effects

Arabic typography must look professionally typeset.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
22. TEXT DENSITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Keep the amount of text LOW.

This is a premium commercial advertisement, NOT a product catalog, nutrition label, or flyer.

Do not copy the entire back label into the design.

Do not display every ingredient or nutritional value.

Select only the strongest, most useful information.

Prioritize:

• visual impact
• immediate comprehension
• product recognition
• readability
• premium presentation

Use short Arabic labels and concise information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
23. FITNESS / NUTRITION VISUAL LANGUAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Communicate fitness through sophistication rather than clichés.

Possible concepts:

• performance
• athletic precision
• strength
• discipline
• clean energy
• wellness
• recovery
• healthy lifestyle
• premium sports culture

The design should communicate these concepts primarily through:

• composition
• product presentation
• typography
• lighting
• scale
• spacing
• color

Do not automatically add gym equipment.

Do not automatically add athletes.

Do not use bodybuilding clichés unless explicitly requested.

The product itself should communicate the fitness or nutrition category whenever possible.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
24. NEGATIVE SPACE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Negative space is one of the MOST IMPORTANT elements of the design.

Use generous breathing room.

Negative space should:

• isolate the product
• improve Arabic readability
• strengthen hierarchy
• reduce visual fatigue
• create elegance
• communicate premium quality

Do not fill empty areas simply because they exist.

Empty space is part of the composition.

The design should breathe.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
25. COMPOSITION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use professional minimalist graphic-design principles.

Possible approaches:

• centered hero
• asymmetric editorial layout
• rule-of-thirds
• strong vertical alignment
• controlled horizontal alignment
• grid-based composition
• large negative-space composition
• product-led editorial composition

Choose the strongest composition automatically based on the product image and extracted information.

The composition must also respect Arabic RTL visual flow.

Do not mechanically follow a template.

Use optical balance rather than rigid mathematical symmetry.

Every element must feel intentionally positioned.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
26. GRID AND ALIGNMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use an invisible professional grid.

Maintain:

• consistent margins
• consistent spacing
• alignment between Arabic text elements
• proportional relationships
• disciplined placement
• visual rhythm

Product, Arabic typography, logo, and information callouts should feel connected through alignment.

Avoid randomly positioned elements.

Do not create excessive columns.

Keep the structure simple.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
27. BRANDING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If a brand name or logo is clearly visible on the product:

Integrate it subtly and professionally.

Do not overpower the product.

Do not redesign the logo.

Do not recreate a fake logo.

Do not invent brand elements.

Do not translate the official brand name unless explicitly requested.

Maintain visual consistency with the original packaging.

The brand should feel like part of the composition rather than an additional sticker.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
28. PREMIUM COMMERCIAL QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The final advertisement should feel suitable for:

• premium sports nutrition brands
• luxury fitness brands
• modern wellness companies
• high-end supplement companies
• athletic lifestyle brands
• professional commercial campaigns
• premium Arabic social-media advertising

Think:

LUXURY FITNESS BRANDING

*

PREMIUM SPORTS NUTRITION

*

MINIMALIST ART DIRECTION

*

ARABIC COMMERCIAL ART DIRECTION

*

COMMERCIAL PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY

*

EDITORIAL GRAPHIC DESIGN

Do NOT make it look like:

• a generic AI poster
• a cheap supplement advertisement
• a gym flyer
• a bodybuilding poster
• a YouTube thumbnail
• a gaming poster
• a crowded Instagram template
• a generic Canva design

The design should feel timeless rather than trendy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
29. IMAGE QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Prioritize extremely high visual quality.

The final artwork must have:

• photorealistic product presentation
• accurate packaging
• realistic materials
• realistic lighting
• realistic shadows
• clean edges
• sharp product details
• natural depth
• professional color grading
• premium art direction
• polished Arabic typography
• commercial-quality finish

Avoid:

• warped packaging
• distorted logos
• duplicated products
• malformed objects
• unreadable Arabic text
• incorrect Arabic typography
• random decorative elements
• unnatural shadows
• unrealistic materials
• inconsistent perspective
• AI artifacts
• invented product information

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
30. FINAL ART-DIRECTION CHECK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before finalizing the artwork, evaluate it as a professional Arabic minimalist commercial art director.

Ask:

Is the product immediately recognizable?

Is the product the strongest visual element?

Did the product analysis use only information actually visible in the uploaded image?

Are all nutritional values and specifications accurate?

Did the design avoid invented claims?

Is all newly generated text in natural, correct Arabic?

Does the typography follow proper RTL composition?

Is the Arabic typography professionally typeset?

Is the composition visually balanced?

Is there enough negative space?

Does the design feel genuinely minimalist?

Is anything unnecessary?

Is the background too complicated?

Are there too many decorative elements?

Does the product feel premium?

Does the lighting feel realistic?

Does the design feel expensive?

Does it look professionally art-directed?

Would a real premium fitness or nutrition brand publish this?

If removing an element makes the composition stronger, REMOVE IT.

The final design must feel:

MINIMAL.
PREMIUM.
CLEAN.
MODERN.
ELEGANT.
REFINED.
CONFIDENT.
TIMELESS.
BALANCED.
ARABIC-FIRST.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.

The goal is NOT to demonstrate how many design elements can be added.

The goal is to make the product look so refined that the simplicity itself becomes the luxury.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
31. FINAL OUTPUT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Generate ONE finished advertisement.

Do not generate multiple variations.

Do not show sketches.

Do not show wireframes.

Do not provide explanations.

Analyze the uploaded product image first.

Extract the reliable product information.

Select the most valuable information.

Determine the appropriate Arabic copy.

Design the composition using the specified Minimalist art direction.

Then generate the final polished commercial artwork directly.

The final visible advertisement should be primarily Arabic and follow a strict RTL visual structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
32. ASPECT RATIO — CHANGE ONLY THIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FINAL ASPECT RATIO:

9:16 VERTICAL PORTRAIT

Design the entire composition specifically for this aspect ratio from the beginning.

Do NOT create another aspect ratio and crop it afterward.

Do NOT stretch, squeeze, or distort the composition.

All visual elements must be intentionally positioned for the specified vertical format.

Maintain safe margins around the product, Arabic typography, logo, nutritional callouts, and all important elements.

The final artwork must be a true 9:16 vertical composition optimized for Instagram Stories, Reels, and vertical social-media presentation.

prompts.title: Glassmorphisim En
prompts.promptText:
Create a premium commercial FITNESS / NUTRITION advertisement using a STRICT, SOPHISTICATED, HIGH-END GLASSMORPHISM DESIGN STYLE.

The final artwork must look like it was created by an elite commercial art director, premium fitness brand designer, professional product photographer, and high-end digital UI/visual designer working together.

The result must feel:

FUTURISTIC.
PREMIUM.
CLEAN.
ELEGANT.
LIGHTWEIGHT.
TRANSLUCENT.
MODERN.
SOPHISTICATED.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.

This is NOT a generic "glass effect" poster.

Do NOT simply place transparent rectangles behind the product.

Create a genuine, professionally art-directed Glassmorphism composition with realistic translucent surfaces, controlled blur, subtle refraction, soft highlights, layered depth, and carefully managed transparency.

The PRODUCT remains the HERO.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. PRODUCT INPUT
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRODUCT IMAGE:

[INSERT PRODUCT IMAGE]

The uploaded product image is the PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH.

The image must be analyzed before creating the advertisement.

Do NOT require the user to manually provide the product information if it can be reliably extracted from the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. PRODUCT IMAGE ANALYSIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before designing the advertisement, carefully inspect the uploaded product image.

Identify and extract ONLY information that is clearly visible and reliably readable from the product packaging.

Analyze:

• Product name
• Product type
• Brand name
• Flavor
• Net weight
• Serving size
• Protein amount per serving
• Calories per serving
• Protein percentage
• Carbohydrates
• Fat
• Ingredients
• Key nutritional information
• Product features
• Product claims
• Certifications
• Any other clearly printed product information

The uploaded packaging is the authoritative source.

Do NOT invent, assume, estimate, infer, or fabricate product information.

If information is partially visible but cannot be read with confidence, DO NOT use it.

If information is completely absent from the image, DO NOT create it.

If nutritional information is visible, preserve the exact values and units shown on the packaging.

Do not convert, reinterpret, round, or modify numerical values unless explicitly requested.

For example:

If the package says "27g Protein", use "27g Protein".

If it says "109 kcal", use "109 kcal".

If it says "1 KG", use "1 KG".

Do not change these values.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. INFORMATION SELECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After analyzing the product image, automatically determine which extracted information is most valuable for a premium commercial advertisement.

Prioritize:

1. Product name
2. Brand name
3. Most important nutritional value
4. Key product specification
5. Net weight
6. Flavor, if relevant
7. One or two important product features

Do NOT attempt to display every piece of information extracted from the packaging.

This is a PREMIUM ADVERTISEMENT, not a nutrition facts sheet.

Select only the information that improves the advertisement.

Use concise visual callouts instead of paragraphs.

For example, if clearly visible on the package, information such as:

27g Protein
109 kcal
86% Protein
1 KG

may be presented as elegant visual highlights.

Only use these values if they are actually visible and readable in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. PRODUCT TITLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically determine the product title from the uploaded packaging.

Use the exact recognizable product name printed on the package whenever possible.

Do NOT invent a new product name.

Do NOT rewrite the brand or product name unnecessarily.

If the product title is unclear, use only the clearly readable portion.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. BRAND IDENTIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically identify the brand from the packaging if clearly visible.

Preserve the original logo and brand identity.

Do NOT redesign the logo.

Do NOT recreate a fake logo.

Do NOT invent brand elements.

The brand should remain visually consistent with the original packaging.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. PRODUCT PRESERVATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the provided product image as the PRIMARY VISUAL SOURCE.

The product is the central visual hero of the entire composition.

Do NOT unnecessarily redesign, deform, replace, recolor, or alter the product packaging.

Preserve:

• exact product shape
• packaging structure
• logo
• brand identity
• printed typography
• label details
• proportions
• colors
• recognizable characteristics
• material appearance

The product must remain immediately recognizable as the exact original product.

If the provided image contains multiple products, preserve the correct number of products.

Do not duplicate products unnecessarily.

Do not generate additional flavors, variants, containers, packages, or accessories unless they are visibly present in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. TEXT GENERATION RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The advertisement may use TWO sources of text:

SOURCE A — USER-PROVIDED TEXT

If the user explicitly provides promotional text, CTA, price, offer, slogan, or campaign message, it may be incorporated into the design.

SOURCE B — PRODUCT-PACKAGING INFORMATION

The AI may extract factual product information directly from the uploaded packaging.
