Are there too many physical objects?

Are there too many textures?

Does anything feel decorative rather than purposeful?

Is there enough negative space?

Does the design look like a premium advertisement rather than a random collection of physical objects?

Does the product feel premium?

Does the design feel tactile?

Does the composition feel expensive?

Would a real premium fitness or nutrition brand publish this?

If removing an element makes the composition stronger, REMOVE IT.

The final design must feel:

TACTILE.
PHYSICAL.
REALISTIC.
PREMIUM.
CRAFTED.
AUTHENTIC.
DETAILED.
REFINED.
SOPHISTICATED.
BALANCED.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.

The goal is NOT to demonstrate how many textures or physical effects can be added.

The goal is to make the advertisement feel like a beautifully crafted physical object while keeping the product unmistakably at the center of attention.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
37. FINAL OUTPUT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Generate ONE finished advertisement.

Do not generate multiple variations.

Do not show sketches.

Do not show wireframes.

Do not provide explanations.

Analyze the uploaded product image first.

Extract the reliable product information.

Select the most valuable information.

Determine the appropriate English copy.

Design the composition using the specified Skeuomorphic art direction.

Then generate the final polished commercial artwork directly.

The final visible advertisement should be primarily English and follow a strict LTR visual structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
38. ASPECT RATIO — CHANGE ONLY THIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FINAL ASPECT RATIO:

9:16 VERTICAL PORTRAIT

Design the entire composition specifically for this aspect ratio from the beginning.

Do NOT create another aspect ratio and crop it afterward.

Do NOT stretch, squeeze, or distort the composition.

All visual elements must be intentionally positioned for the specified vertical format.

Maintain safe margins around the product, English typography, logo, physical labels, nutritional callouts, and all important elements.

The final artwork must be a true 9:16 vertical composition optimized for Instagram Stories, Reels, and vertical social-media presentation.

prompts.title: Skeuomorphism
prompts.promptText:
Create a premium commercial FITNESS / NUTRITION advertisement using a STRICT, SOPHISTICATED, HIGH-END SKEUOMORPHISM DESIGN STYLE.

The final artwork must be designed specifically for an ARABIC-SPEAKING AUDIENCE.

Arabic must be the PRIMARY visual language of the final advertisement.

The entire composition must follow a natural RIGHT-TO-LEFT (RTL) visual and typographic flow.

The final artwork must look like it was created by an elite commercial art director, premium fitness brand designer, professional product photographer, tactile product designer, Arabic typography specialist, and high-end Skeuomorphic visual designer working together.

The result must feel:

TACTILE.
REALISTIC.
PREMIUM.
PHYSICAL.
AUTHENTIC.
CRAFTED.
REFINED.
DETAILED.
MODERN.
SOPHISTICATED.
COMMERCIAL.
ARABIC-FIRST.
EASY ON THE EYES.

This is NOT a generic "realistic poster."

Do NOT simply add textures, shadows, and 3D objects randomly.

Create a genuine, professionally art-directed Skeuomorphic composition where digital graphic elements visually behave like real physical materials and objects.

The design should create the impression that the viewer could physically touch, press, open, lift, slide, emboss, peel, or interact with the visual elements.

The PRODUCT remains the HERO.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. PRODUCT INPUT
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRODUCT IMAGE:

[INSERT PRODUCT IMAGE]

The uploaded product image is the PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH.

The image must be analyzed before creating the advertisement.

Do NOT require the user to manually provide product information if it can be reliably extracted from the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. PRODUCT IMAGE ANALYSIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before designing the advertisement, carefully inspect the uploaded product image.

Identify and extract ONLY information that is clearly visible and reliably readable from the product packaging.

Analyze:

• اسم المنتج
• نوع المنتج
• اسم العلامة التجارية
• النكهة
• الوزن الصافي
• حجم الحصة
• كمية البروتين في الحصة
• السعرات الحرارية في الحصة
• نسبة البروتين
• الكربوهيدرات
• الدهون
• المكونات
• المعلومات الغذائية الأساسية
• خصائص المنتج
• ادعاءات المنتج
• الشهادات
• أي معلومات أخرى مطبوعة بوضوح على العبوة

The uploaded packaging is the authoritative source.

Do NOT invent, assume, estimate, infer, or fabricate product information.

If information is partially visible but cannot be read with confidence, DO NOT use it.

If information is completely absent from the image, DO NOT create it.

If nutritional information is visible, preserve the exact values and units shown on the packaging.

Do not convert, reinterpret, round, or modify numerical values unless explicitly requested.

For example:

If the package says:

"27g Protein"

the Arabic advertisement may present it as:

"27 غ بروتين"

If it says:

"109 kcal"

it may be presented as:

"109 سعرة حرارية"

If it says:

"1 KG"

it may be presented as:

"1 كغ"

The factual numerical value must remain unchanged.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. INFORMATION SELECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After analyzing the product image, automatically determine which extracted information is most valuable for a premium Skeuomorphic commercial advertisement.

Prioritize:

1. اسم المنتج
2. اسم العلامة التجارية
3. أهم قيمة غذائية
4. أهم مواصفة للمنتج
5. الوزن الصافي
6. النكهة، إذا كانت مهمة
7. خاصية أو خاصيتان مهمتان للمنتج

Do NOT attempt to display every piece of information extracted from the packaging.

This is a PREMIUM ADVERTISEMENT, not a nutrition facts sheet.

Select only the information that improves the advertisement.

Use concise Arabic visual callouts instead of paragraphs.

Only use nutritional values and specifications that are actually visible and readable in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. PRODUCT TITLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically determine the product title from the uploaded packaging.

Use the exact recognizable product name printed on the package whenever possible.

Do NOT invent a new product name.

Do NOT unnecessarily rewrite the brand or product name.

If the official product name is in English or another language, preserve the official product name when appropriate.

If a generic descriptive phrase can be naturally translated into Arabic without changing the product identity, translate it professionally.

Do NOT translate official brand names.

If the product title is unclear, use only the clearly readable portion.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. BRAND IDENTIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically identify the brand from the packaging if clearly visible.

Preserve the original logo and brand identity.

Do NOT redesign the logo.

Do NOT recreate a fake logo.

Do NOT invent brand elements.

Do NOT translate the official brand name unless explicitly requested.

The brand should remain visually consistent with the original packaging.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. PRODUCT PRESERVATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the provided product image as the PRIMARY VISUAL SOURCE.

The product is the central visual hero of the entire composition.

Do NOT unnecessarily redesign, deform, replace, recolor, or alter the product packaging.

Preserve:

• exact product shape
• packaging structure
• logo
• brand identity
• printed typography
• label details
• proportions
• colors
• recognizable characteristics
• material appearance

The product must remain immediately recognizable as the exact original product.

If the provided image contains multiple products, preserve the correct number of products.

Do not duplicate products unnecessarily.

Do not generate additional flavors, variants, containers, packages, or accessories unless they are visibly present in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. TEXT GENERATION RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The advertisement may use TWO primary sources of text:

SOURCE A — USER-PROVIDED TEXT

If the user explicitly provides promotional text, CTA, price, offer, slogan, or campaign message, it may be incorporated into the design.

If the user-provided promotional text is in English but the final advertisement is intended for an Arabic-speaking audience, translate it naturally into professional Arabic unless the user explicitly requests English.

SOURCE B — PRODUCT-PACKAGING INFORMATION

The AI may extract factual product information directly from the uploaded packaging.

This includes clearly readable:

• اسم المنتج
• اسم العلامة التجارية
• القيم الغذائية
• مواصفات المنتج
• النكهة
• الوزن
• خصائص المنتج
• الادعاءات المطبوعة

ONLY use information that is clearly supported by the uploaded image or explicitly provided by the user.

All newly generated marketing text must be written in NATURAL, PROFESSIONAL, CORRECT ARABIC.

The copy must feel premium, concise, modern, and commercially appropriate.

Do NOT invent:

• nutritional facts
• ingredients
• calories
• protein percentages
• health claims
• medical claims
• prices
• discounts
• certifications
• awards
• statistics
• testimonials
• product specifications
• performance claims

Do not create marketing claims that are not supported by the packaging or user-provided information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
8. FACTUAL ACCURACY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This is CRITICAL.

Every factual product statement in the advertisement must be traceable to either:

1. The uploaded product packaging

OR

2. Information explicitly provided by the user.

Never fill missing information with assumptions.

Never use generic supplement statistics.

Never invent benefits simply because the product belongs to a particular category.

For example:

Do NOT automatically claim:

"يساعد على بناء العضلات"

"يحرق الدهون"

"يعزز هرمون التستوستيرون"

"يحسن الاستشفاء"

"مثبت سريريًا"

"نقي 100%"

"خالي من السكر"

"امتصاص سريع"

unless the claim is explicitly visible on the packaging or explicitly provided by the user.

Accuracy is more important than adding more text.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
9. LANGUAGE HANDLING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The FINAL ADVERTISEMENT must be ARABIC-FIRST.

All newly generated:

• headlines
• subtitles
• promotional messages
• CTAs
• supporting text
• product information callouts
• descriptive text

must be written in professional Arabic.

Use NATURAL MODERN ARABIC suitable for commercial fitness and nutrition advertising.

Use correct:

• spelling
• grammar
• punctuation
• Arabic typography
• RTL direction
• text hierarchy
• Arabic letter connections

Do NOT generate pseudo-Arabic text.

Do NOT generate meaningless Arabic-like text.

Do NOT reverse Arabic text.

Do NOT mirror Arabic letters incorrectly.

All Arabic text must read naturally from RIGHT TO LEFT.

The visual composition must also respect RTL reading flow.

The viewer's eye should naturally move through the design according to Arabic visual reading direction.

Do NOT introduce unnecessary bilingual text.

English should only remain when it is part of:

• the original product packaging
• the official brand identity
• the official product name
• a user-provided element that the user explicitly wants preserved

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
10. ARABIC SKEUOMORPHIC COPY STYLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use short, sophisticated, premium Arabic advertising language.

The copy should feel:

• modern
• confident
• concise
• natural
• professional
• premium
• performance-oriented

Avoid:

• cheap advertising language
• exaggerated claims
• long sentences
• unnecessary slogans
• excessive punctuation
• excessive exclamation marks
• generic motivational clichés

Prefer concise commercial Arabic.

Examples of STYLE only:

"أداء أقوى يبدأ من هنا"

"طاقة تدعم أداءك"

"اختيارك للأداء الأفضل"

"مصمم لأداءك اليومي"

"قوة في كل جرعة"

These are examples of tone and structure only.

Do NOT automatically use these phrases unless they are appropriate to the specific product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
11. CORE SKEUOMORPHISM DIRECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a sophisticated PREMIUM SKEUOMORPHIC visual system.

The fundamental principle is:

DIGITAL GRAPHIC ELEMENTS SHOULD LOOK AND BEHAVE LIKE REAL PHYSICAL OBJECTS.

Use realistic physical metaphors such as:

• leather
• paper
• brushed metal
• polished metal
• rubber
• molded plastic
• fabric
• canvas
• wood
• cardboard
• embossed surfaces
• stitched surfaces
• printed labels
• physical tags
• engraved plates
• tactile buttons
• physical switches
• realistic cards
• textured surfaces

Choose materials according to the product and brand.

Do NOT use every material simultaneously.

Select a coherent material language.

Every physical element must appear to belong to the same real-world environment.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
12. PRODUCT PRIORITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The product MUST remain more visually important than every Skeuomorphic element.

The physical environment is the supporting visual system.

The product must remain:

• sharp
• recognizable
• readable
• visually dominant
• physically grounded

Do not hide the product behind decorative objects.

Do not cover important packaging details.

Do not transform the actual product into an unrelated physical object.

The product itself must remain authentic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
13. VISUAL HIERARCHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Establish a strict visual hierarchy:

1. PRODUCT
2. ARABIC PRODUCT TITLE / PRIMARY MESSAGE
3. KEY PRODUCT INFORMATION
4. BRAND
5. SUPPORTING INFORMATION
6. CTA, if provided

The product must immediately attract attention.

Arabic typography must remain secondary to the product.

Physical decorative elements must remain supportive.

The viewer should understand the advertisement within approximately one second.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
14. MATERIAL SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a coherent physical material system.

Select only materials that complement the product.

Possible combinations include:

• matte paper + embossed ink
• dark leather + metallic details
• brushed aluminum + rubber
• premium cardboard + printed labels
• textured fabric + stitched patches
• molded matte plastic + engraved controls

Materials must have realistic:

• texture
• roughness
• reflectivity
• imperfections
• edge behavior
• light response
• depth

Avoid generic CGI materials.

Avoid overly perfect surfaces.

Real materials should have subtle physical imperfections.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
15. EMBOSSING AND DEBOSSING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use physical print techniques where appropriate.

Possible treatments:

• embossed logo
• debossed title
• raised lettering
• pressed typography
• engraved information
• stamped marks
• foil-like physical details

These effects must appear physically integrated into the material.

Do NOT simply add a drop shadow behind text.

The viewer should believe the typography is physically printed, pressed, stamped, or engraved.

Keep these effects restrained.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16. PHYSICAL LABELS AND TAGS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use physical-looking information elements when appropriate.

Possible forms:

• paper labels
• hanging tags
• adhesive labels
• metal plaques
• stitched patches
• printed cards
• embossed badges
• small physical specification plates

These elements may contain verified product information.

They must feel physically attached to the environment.

Use realistic:

• attachment
• folds
• thickness
• edges
• shadows
• material interaction

Do NOT create random decorative labels.

Every label must communicate something useful.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
17. PHYSICAL CONTROLS AND INTERACTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If interface-inspired elements are used, they must appear physically real.

Possible elements:

• tactile buttons
• rotary dials
• switches
• sliders
• knobs
• mechanical indicators
• physical toggles

Use them very sparingly.

They should support the advertising concept rather than make the design look like a dashboard.

Do NOT create a fake application interface.

Do NOT fill the design with unnecessary controls.

Every control must have a clear visual or conceptual purpose.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
18. SHADOW SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use realistic physical shadows.

Shadows should communicate:

• object height
• contact
• thickness
• depth
• physical placement

Use:

• contact shadows
• cast shadows
• ambient occlusion
• subtle directional shadows

Maintain a consistent light source.

Objects must not appear to float unless intentionally suspended.

Avoid:

• hard artificial shadows
• inconsistent shadow directions
• excessive black shadows
• excessive blur
• fake floating objects

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
19. HIGHLIGHT AND REFLECTION SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use realistic material-specific highlights.

Metal should behave like metal.

Plastic should behave like plastic.

Leather should behave like leather.

Paper should remain mostly matte.

Rubber should remain soft and low-reflective.

Glass, if used, should behave like real glass.

Do not use the same reflection style on every material.

The light response must reinforce the physical identity of each surface.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
20. BACKGROUND
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a sophisticated physical environment that supports the product.

Possible environments include:

• premium studio tabletop
• textured paper surface
• matte stone
• brushed metal surface
• refined leather surface
• clean wooden surface
• premium fabric surface
• minimal industrial surface

Choose the environment according to the product.

Keep the environment restrained.

Do NOT create an overly elaborate scene.

Do NOT automatically place the product inside a gym.

Do NOT add unrelated fitness equipment.

The background should establish physical context without competing with the product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
21. PRODUCT PRESENTATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Treat the product as a premium real-world commercial product.

Present it with:

• realistic scale
• accurate perspective
• natural contact with the surface
• realistic weight
• believable placement
• physically accurate shadows
• professional lighting

The product may be:

• centered
• slightly off-center
• aligned to a grid
• positioned using the rule of thirds
• placed within a tactile editorial composition

Choose the strongest placement automatically.

The product must feel physically present rather than digitally pasted into the scene.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
22. PRODUCT LIGHTING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium commercial product photography lighting.

The product must have:

• realistic highlights
• realistic shadows
• accurate material response
• dimensional form
• sharp edges
• realistic contact with the environment

Lighting should reveal both the product and the physical environment.

Do NOT over-light the scene.

Do NOT create dramatic cinematic lighting unless it genuinely improves the product.

Maintain realistic material response.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
23. DEPTH AND PHYSICALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create convincing physical depth.

Use:

• object thickness
• layered materials
• realistic edges
• contact shadows
• cast shadows
• subtle perspective
• physical overlap
• material interaction
• realistic scale

Objects should feel like they occupy real space.

Do not make everything perfectly flat.

Do not make everything dramatically 3D.

The physical depth should feel natural.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
24. INFORMATION CALLOUTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When reliable nutritional or product information has been extracted from the packaging, present only the most important values as physical-looking information elements.

Examples:

27 غ بروتين

109 سعرة حرارية

86% بروتين

1 كغ

These are ONLY examples of formatting.

Do not automatically use these numbers unless they are actually visible on the uploaded product packaging.

Information may be presented as:

• embossed labels
• printed paper cards
• engraved metal plates
• stitched patches
• physical tags
• stamped labels
• tactile specification panels

Choose the format that best fits the material language.

Do not turn the advertisement into an infographic.

Do not display too many numbers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
25. DISTRACTION CONTROL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THIS IS CRITICAL.

Skeuomorphism can easily become overloaded with textures and objects.

Avoid that.

The advertisement must remain extremely easy on the eyes.

DO NOT add:

• random physical objects
• unnecessary buttons
• random switches
• excessive labels
• excessive badges
• random gym equipment
• random dumbbells
• random weights
• bodybuilding silhouettes
• unrelated athletes
• random ingredients
• excessive textures
• excessive stitching
• excessive metallic objects
• excessive leather
• excessive wood
• excessive paper
• excessive reflections
• excessive shadows
• smoke
• fire
• explosions
• lightning
• excessive particles
• fake statistics
• fake product claims
• fake certifications
• visual clutter

Do NOT make the advertisement look like a collection of unrelated objects.

Every physical element must have a clear purpose.

If an element does not improve the product presentation, REMOVE IT.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
26. COLOR SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Build the color system around the actual product packaging.

Extract the dominant visual colors from the product.

Use a restrained physical color palette.

Prefer:

• one dominant environmental tone
• product colors
• one material tone
• one subtle accent

Choose material colors that complement the product.

Avoid unrelated colors.

Avoid excessive saturation.

Avoid rainbow effects.

The physical materials should support the product's existing brand identity rather than compete with it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
27. ARABIC TYPOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium modern Arabic typography.

Typography should be:

• clean
• sophisticated
• highly readable
• balanced
• contemporary
• physically integrated

Prefer professional Arabic sans-serif typography such as:

• Cairo
• IBM Plex Sans Arabic
• DIN Next Arabic style
• modern geometric Arabic sans-serif
• clean contemporary Arabic typography

Use no more than TWO typefaces.

All typography must follow RIGHT-TO-LEFT (RTL) direction.

Typography may visually behave like a physical material:

• printed ink
• embossed lettering
• debossed lettering
• engraved text
• stamped typography
• foil-like physical print

However, readability always comes first.

Do NOT use:

• decorative Arabic fonts
• childish fonts
• excessive calligraphy
• unreadable vintage Arabic fonts
• excessive outlines
• glowing Arabic text
• neon text
• excessive gradients
• excessive text effects

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
28. TEXT DENSITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Keep the amount of text LOW.

This is a premium commercial advertisement, NOT a product catalog, nutrition label, or flyer.

Do not copy the entire back label into the design.

Do not display every ingredient or nutritional value.

Select only the strongest, most useful information.

Prioritize:

• visual impact
• immediate comprehension
• product recognition
• readability
• tactile presentation
• premium perception

Use short Arabic labels and concise information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
29. FITNESS / NUTRITION VISUAL LANGUAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Communicate fitness through physical authenticity.

Possible concepts:

• performance
• strength
• craftsmanship
• precision
• discipline
• durability
• wellness
• recovery
• premium sports culture
• physical performance

Skeuomorphism should reinforce a sense of:

REAL-WORLD PERFORMANCE.

The design should feel tangible and grounded.

Do not automatically add gym equipment.

Do not automatically add athletes.

Do not use bodybuilding clichés unless explicitly requested.

The product itself should communicate the fitness or nutrition category whenever possible.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
30. NEGATIVE SPACE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Maintain generous breathing room.

Skeuomorphism requires controlled visual density.

Do not fill empty areas with random objects or textures.

Negative space should create:

• focus
• clarity
• elegance
• visual breathing room
• premium perception

Allow physical objects to have room around them.

Do not make the scene feel like a tabletop covered with objects.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
31. COMPOSITION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use professional commercial composition.

Possible approaches:

• central hero
• asymmetric editorial composition
• rule-of-thirds
• product-led tabletop composition
• tactile layered composition
• controlled diagonal flow
• grid-based composition

Choose the strongest composition automatically based on the product image and extracted information.

Do not mechanically follow a template.

The composition must feel custom-designed for the specific product.

Maintain a consistent RTL visual flow.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
32. GRID AND ALIGNMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use an invisible professional grid.

Maintain:

• consistent margins
• consistent spacing
• alignment between Arabic text elements
• proportional relationships
• disciplined placement
• visual rhythm

Product, Arabic typography, logo, physical labels, and information elements should feel connected through alignment.

Avoid randomly positioned objects.

Do not create excessive columns.

Keep the structure simple.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
33. BRANDING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If a brand name or logo is clearly visible on the product:

Integrate it subtly and professionally.

Do not overpower the product.

Do not redesign the logo.

Do not recreate a fake logo.

Do not invent brand elements.

Do not translate the official brand name unless explicitly requested.

Maintain visual consistency with the original packaging.

The brand should feel physically integrated into the composition rather than pasted on afterward.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
34. PREMIUM COMMERCIAL QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The final advertisement should feel suitable for:

• premium sports nutrition brands
• luxury fitness brands
• modern wellness companies
• high-end supplement companies
• athletic lifestyle brands
• premium performance brands
• professional Arabic commercial campaigns

Think:

LUXURY FITNESS BRANDING

*

PREMIUM SPORTS NUTRITION

*

HIGH-END SKEUOMORPHISM

*

TACTILE PRODUCT DESIGN

*

ARABIC COMMERCIAL ART DIRECTION

*

COMMERCIAL PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY

*

PHYSICAL MATERIAL CRAFTSMANSHIP

Do NOT make it look like:

• a generic AI poster
• a cheap supplement advertisement
• a vintage collage
• a cluttered scrapbook
• a mobile app interface
• a dashboard
• a gaming poster
• a bodybuilding poster
• a random 3D scene
• a crowded Instagram template
• a generic Canva design

The design should feel premium, physical, authentic, and intentionally crafted.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
35. IMAGE QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Prioritize extremely high visual quality.

The final artwork must have:

• photorealistic product presentation
• accurate packaging
• realistic physical materials
• believable textures
• realistic surface imperfections
• accurate object thickness
• realistic shadows
• realistic reflections
• physically believable lighting
• clean edges
• sharp product details
• sophisticated depth
• professional color grading
• premium art direction
• polished Arabic typography
• commercial-quality finish

Avoid:

• warped packaging
• distorted logos
• duplicated products
• malformed objects
• unreadable Arabic text
• incorrect Arabic typography
• fake textures
• plastic-looking leather
• artificial-looking paper
• unrealistic metal
• excessive gloss
• inconsistent lighting
• inconsistent perspective
• impossible object geometry
• AI artifacts
• invented product information

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
36. FINAL ART-DIRECTION CHECK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before finalizing the artwork, evaluate it as a professional Arabic commercial Skeuomorphic art director.

Ask:

Is the product immediately recognizable?

Is the product the strongest visual element?

Did the product analysis use only information actually visible in the uploaded image?

Are all nutritional values and specifications accurate?

Did the design avoid invented claims?

Is all newly generated text in natural, correct Arabic?

Does the typography follow proper RTL composition?

Is the Arabic typography professionally typeset?

Do the physical materials look believable?

Does each material behave according to its physical properties?

Do the shadows communicate real object placement?

Are the reflections appropriate for each material?

Do objects have believable thickness?

Does the environment feel physically coherent?

Are there too many physical objects?

Are there too many textures?

Does anything feel decorative rather than purposeful?

Is there enough negative space?

Does the design look like a premium advertisement rather than a random collection of physical objects?

Does the product feel premium?

Does the design feel tactile?

Does the composition feel expensive?

Would a real premium fitness or nutrition brand publish this?

If removing an element makes the composition stronger, REMOVE IT.

The final design must feel:

TACTILE.
PHYSICAL.
REALISTIC.
PREMIUM.
CRAFTED.
AUTHENTIC.
DETAILED.
REFINED.
SOPHISTICATED.
BALANCED.
ARABIC-FIRST.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.

The goal is NOT to demonstrate how many textures or physical effects can be added.

The goal is to make the advertisement feel like a beautifully crafted physical object while keeping the product unmistakably at the center of attention.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
37. FINAL OUTPUT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Generate ONE finished advertisement.

Do not generate multiple variations.

Do not show sketches.

Do not show wireframes.

Do not provide explanations.

Analyze the uploaded product image first.

Extract the reliable product information.

Select the most valuable information.

Determine the appropriate Arabic copy.

Design the composition using the specified Skeuomorphic art direction.

Then generate the final polished commercial artwork directly.

The final visible advertisement should be primarily Arabic and follow a strict RTL visual structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
38. ASPECT RATIO — CHANGE ONLY THIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FINAL ASPECT RATIO:

9:16 VERTICAL PORTRAIT

Design the entire composition specifically for this aspect ratio from the beginning.

Do NOT create another aspect ratio and crop it afterward.

Do NOT stretch, squeeze, or distort the composition.

All visual elements must be intentionally positioned for the specified vertical format.

Maintain safe margins around the product, Arabic typography, logo, physical labels, nutritional callouts, and all important elements.

The final artwork must be a true 9:16 vertical composition optimized for Instagram Stories, Reels, and vertical social-media presentation.

prompts.title: Flat Design En
prompts.promptText:
Create a premium commercial FITNESS / NUTRITION advertisement using a STRICT, SOPHISTICATED, HIGH-END FLAT DESIGN STYLE.

The final artwork must be designed specifically for an ENGLISH-SPEAKING AUDIENCE.

English must be the PRIMARY visual language of the final advertisement.

The entire composition must follow a natural LEFT-TO-RIGHT (LTR) visual and typographic flow.

The final artwork must look like it was created by an elite commercial art director, premium fitness brand designer, professional product photographer, flat-design specialist, typography specialist, and high-end visual communication designer working together.

The result must feel:

CLEAN.
BOLD.
MODERN.
SIMPLE.
PREMIUM.
GRAPHIC.
CONFIDENT.
CRISP.
BALANCED.
INTENTIONAL.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.

This is NOT a generic "simple poster."

Do NOT simply remove shadows and place a product on a colored background.

Create a genuine, professionally art-directed Flat Design composition based on simplified geometry, bold visual hierarchy, clean shapes, controlled color, precise spacing, strong typography, visual clarity, and deliberate reduction of unnecessary detail.

The PRODUCT remains the HERO.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. PRODUCT INPUT
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRODUCT IMAGE:

[INSERT PRODUCT IMAGE]

The uploaded product image is the PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH.

The image must be analyzed before creating the advertisement.

Do NOT require the user to manually provide product information if it can be reliably extracted from the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. PRODUCT IMAGE ANALYSIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before designing the advertisement, carefully inspect the uploaded product image.

Identify and extract ONLY information that is clearly visible and reliably readable from the product packaging.

Analyze:

• Product name
• Product type
• Brand name
• Flavor
• Net weight
• Serving size
• Protein amount per serving
• Calories per serving
• Protein percentage
• Carbohydrates
• Fat
• Ingredients
• Key nutritional information
• Product features
• Product claims
• Certifications
• Any other clearly printed product information

The uploaded packaging is the authoritative source.

Do NOT invent, assume, estimate, infer, or fabricate product information.

If information is partially visible but cannot be read with confidence, DO NOT use it.

If information is completely absent from the image, DO NOT create it.

If nutritional information is visible, preserve the exact factual values and units shown on the packaging.

Do not convert, reinterpret, round, or modify numerical values unless explicitly requested.

For example:

If the package says:

"27g Protein"

use:

"27g Protein"

If it says:

"109 kcal"

use:

"109 kcal"

If it says:

"1 KG"

use:

"1 KG"

The factual numerical value must remain unchanged.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. INFORMATION SELECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After analyzing the product image, automatically determine which extracted information is most valuable for a premium Flat Design commercial advertisement.

Prioritize:

1. Product name
2. Brand name
3. Most important nutritional value
4. Key product specification
5. Net weight
6. Flavor, if relevant
7. One or two important product features

Do NOT attempt to display every piece of information extracted from the packaging.

This is a PREMIUM ADVERTISEMENT, not a nutrition facts sheet.

Select only the information that improves the advertisement.

Use concise English visual callouts instead of paragraphs.

For example, if clearly visible on the package:

27g Protein
109 kcal
86% Protein
1 KG

may be presented as clean graphic information highlights.

Only use these values if they are actually visible and readable in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. PRODUCT TITLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically determine the product title from the uploaded packaging.

Use the exact recognizable product name printed on the packaging whenever possible.

Do NOT invent a new product name.

Do NOT unnecessarily rewrite the brand or product name.

If the official product name is clearly written in English, preserve it accurately.

If a generic descriptive phrase can be naturally presented in English without changing the product identity, use professional wording.

If the product title is unclear, use only the clearly readable portion.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. BRAND IDENTIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically identify the brand from the packaging if clearly visible.

Preserve the original logo and brand identity.

Do NOT redesign the logo.

Do NOT recreate a fake logo.

Do NOT invent brand elements.

The brand should remain visually consistent with the original packaging.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. PRODUCT PRESERVATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the provided product image as the PRIMARY VISUAL SOURCE.

The product is the central visual hero of the entire composition.

Do NOT unnecessarily redesign, deform, replace, recolor, or alter the product packaging.

Preserve:

• exact product shape
• packaging structure
• logo
• brand identity
• printed typography
• label details
• proportions
• colors
• recognizable characteristics
• material appearance

The product must remain immediately recognizable as the exact original product.

If the provided image contains multiple products, preserve the correct number of products.

Do not duplicate products unnecessarily.

Do not generate additional flavors, variants, containers, packages, or accessories unless they are visibly present in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. TEXT GENERATION RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The advertisement may use TWO primary sources of text:

SOURCE A — USER-PROVIDED TEXT

If the user explicitly provides promotional text, CTA, price, offer, slogan, or campaign message, it may be incorporated into the design.

SOURCE B — PRODUCT-PACKAGING INFORMATION

The AI may extract factual product information directly from the uploaded packaging.

This includes clearly readable:

• Product name
• Brand name
• Nutritional values
• Product specifications
• Flavor
• Weight
• Product features
• Printed claims

ONLY use information that is clearly supported by the uploaded image or explicitly provided by the user.

All newly generated marketing text must be written in NATURAL, PROFESSIONAL ENGLISH.

The copy must feel premium, concise, modern, and commercially appropriate.

Do NOT invent:

• nutritional facts
• ingredients
• calories
• protein percentages
• health claims
• medical claims
• prices
• discounts
• certifications
• awards
• statistics
• testimonials
• product specifications
• performance claims

Do not create marketing claims that are not supported by the packaging or user-provided information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
8. FACTUAL ACCURACY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This is CRITICAL.

Every factual product statement in the advertisement must be traceable to either:

1. The uploaded product packaging

OR

2. Information explicitly provided by the user.

Never fill missing information with assumptions.

Never use generic supplement statistics.

Never invent benefits simply because the product belongs to a particular category.

For example:

Do NOT automatically claim:

"Builds muscle"

"Burns fat"

"Boosts testosterone"

"Improves recovery"

"Clinically proven"

"100% pure"

"Zero sugar"

"Fast absorption"

unless the claim is explicitly visible on the packaging or explicitly provided by the user.

Accuracy is more important than adding more text.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
9. LANGUAGE HANDLING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The FINAL ADVERTISEMENT must be ENGLISH-FIRST.

All newly generated:

• headlines
• subtitles
• promotional messages
• CTAs
• supporting text
• product information callouts
• descriptive text

must be written in professional English.

Use NATURAL MODERN ENGLISH suitable for commercial fitness and nutrition advertising.

Use correct:

• spelling
• grammar
• punctuation
• capitalization
• typography
• LTR direction
• text hierarchy

Do NOT generate pseudo-English text.

Do NOT generate meaningless text.

Do NOT reverse text.

Do NOT mirror letters incorrectly.

All English text must read naturally from LEFT TO RIGHT.

The visual composition must also respect LTR reading flow.

Do NOT introduce unnecessary bilingual text.

English should remain the dominant language throughout the advertisement.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
10. FLAT-DESIGN COPY STYLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use short, sophisticated, premium English advertising language.

The copy should feel:

• modern
• confident
• concise
• natural
• professional
• energetic
• performance-oriented

Avoid:

• cheap advertising language
• exaggerated claims
• long sentences
• unnecessary slogans
• excessive punctuation
• excessive exclamation marks
• generic motivational clichés

Prefer concise commercial language.

Examples of STYLE only:

"Built for Performance"

"Power Your Performance"

"Performance Starts Here"

"Train. Perform. Recover."

"Fuel Your Next Level"

These are examples of tone and structure only.

Do NOT automatically use these phrases unless they are appropriate to the specific product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
11. CORE FLAT-DESIGN DIRECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a sophisticated PREMIUM FLAT DESIGN visual system.

Flat Design must be treated as a deliberate visual communication system, not simply a design without shadows.

Use:

• simplified geometry
• clean vector-like shapes
• bold color blocks
• strong hierarchy
• crisp edges
• controlled proportions
• visual rhythm
• simple forms
• intentional negative space
• precise alignment
• restrained detail

The visual language should communicate maximum clarity with minimum visual complexity.

Use visual reduction intelligently.

Simplify supporting graphics while preserving the realism and recognizability of the actual product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
12. PRODUCT PRIORITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The product MUST remain more visually important than every graphic element.

The Flat Design system is the supporting visual language.

The product must remain:

• sharp
• recognizable
• readable
• visually dominant
• physically believable

Do NOT flatten or distort the actual product.

Do NOT turn the product packaging into a cartoon illustration.

Do NOT replace the product with a vector representation.

The real product image must remain the hero.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
13. VISUAL HIERARCHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Establish a strict visual hierarchy:

1. PRODUCT
2. PRODUCT TITLE / PRIMARY MESSAGE
3. KEY PRODUCT INFORMATION
4. BRAND
5. SUPPORTING INFORMATION
6. CTA, if provided

The product must immediately attract attention.

Typography must remain secondary to the product.

Graphic elements must remain supportive.

The viewer should understand the advertisement within approximately one second.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
14. GRAPHIC SHAPE SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use a controlled geometric language.

Possible shapes include:

• circles
• rounded rectangles
• capsules
• squares
• clean lines
• arcs
• simple curves
• geometric blocks
• minimal abstract forms

Use shapes to support:

• hierarchy
• direction
• framing
• information grouping
• product emphasis
• visual rhythm

Do NOT add random shapes merely to fill empty space.

Every shape must have a clear compositional purpose.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
15. COLOR BLOCKING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use strong, deliberate color blocking.

Build the palette around the actual product packaging and brand identity.

Prefer:

• one dominant background color
• product colors
• one supporting neutral
• one controlled accent color

Use bold areas of flat color where appropriate.

Colors should feel intentional rather than decorative.

Avoid:

• uncontrolled gradients
• rainbow palettes
• excessive color variety
• unrelated colors
• muddy color combinations

The product should remain the strongest source of visual identity.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16. BACKGROUND
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a clean, sophisticated Flat Design background.

Possible approaches:

• solid color
• two-tone composition
• simple geometric field
• restrained color blocks
• minimal abstract pattern
• clean editorial background

Choose the background according to the product and brand.

The background must remain visually quiet enough to support the product.

Avoid realistic environments unless explicitly requested.

Do NOT automatically create a gym scene.

Do NOT add random fitness equipment.

Do NOT use photographic backgrounds unless they genuinely support the Flat Design concept.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
17. PRODUCT PRESENTATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Treat the product as a premium commercial product-photography subject placed inside a Flat Design graphic environment.

Present it with:

• accurate scale
• realistic perspective
• clean positioning
• subtle grounding
• controlled visual separation

The product may be:

• centered
• slightly off-center
• aligned to a geometric grid
• positioned using the rule of thirds
• framed by simple graphic shapes

Choose the strongest placement automatically.

The actual product must remain realistic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
18. DEPTH AND SHADOW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Flat Design should use depth very sparingly.

If shadows are used, they must be:

• subtle
• clean
• controlled
• minimal
• purposeful

Prefer simple:

• contact shadows
• soft grounding shadows
• minimal offset shadows

Avoid:

• dramatic 3D shadows
• photorealistic environmental shadows
• excessive blur
• heavy drop shadows
• floating objects
• complex lighting effects

The design should remain visually flat while the product retains its natural photographic depth.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
19. ICONOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If icons are necessary, use a consistent minimalist icon system.

Icons should be:

• simple
• geometric
• clean
• immediately understandable
• visually consistent

Use icons only when they improve comprehension.

Possible applications:

• protein
• calories
• weight
• serving information
• product features

Do NOT use decorative icons without purpose.

Do NOT use multiple unrelated icon styles.

Do NOT turn the advertisement into an infographic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
20. INFORMATION CALLOUTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When reliable nutritional or product information has been extracted from the packaging, present only the most important values as clean Flat Design information blocks.

Examples:

27g
PROTEIN

109
KCAL

86%
PROTEIN

1 KG

These are ONLY examples of formatting.

Do not automatically use these numbers unless they are actually visible on the uploaded product packaging.

Information may be presented using:

• clean cards
• simple geometric containers
• circular information markers
• bold numeric blocks
• minimal dividers
• flat color panels

Keep them concise.

Do not create a dashboard.

Do not display too many numbers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
21. DISTRACTION CONTROL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THIS IS CRITICAL.

Flat Design can easily become overloaded with decorative shapes and colors.

Avoid that.

The advertisement must remain extremely easy on the eyes.

DO NOT add:

• random geometric shapes
• excessive circles
• excessive color blocks
• random lines
• unnecessary icons
• excessive patterns
• random gym equipment
• random dumbbells
• random weights
• bodybuilding silhouettes
• unrelated athletes
• random ingredients
• excessive gradients
• excessive shadows
• excessive outlines
• excessive typography
• fake statistics
• fake product claims
• fake certifications
• visual clutter

Do NOT create a generic vector poster.

Do NOT make every available space colorful.

If an element does not improve the product presentation, REMOVE IT.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
22. TYPOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium modern English typography.

Typography should be:

• bold
• clean
• highly readable
• modern
• confident
• geometric
• professionally balanced

Use no more than TWO typefaces.

Prefer:

• modern sans-serif
• geometric sans-serif
• neo-grotesk
• contemporary editorial typography

Use typography as a major graphic element.

Possible treatments:

• large headline
• bold numeric emphasis
• clean supporting text
• compact labels
• strong uppercase product attributes

All typography must follow LEFT-TO-RIGHT (LTR) direction.

Do NOT use:

• decorative fonts
• childish fonts
• excessive script fonts
• distorted typography
• glowing text
• metallic text
• excessive gradients
• excessive outlines
• excessive text effects

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
23. TEXT DENSITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Keep the amount of text LOW.

This is a premium commercial advertisement, NOT a product catalog, nutrition label, or flyer.

Do not copy the entire back label into the design.

Do not display every ingredient or nutritional value.

Select only the strongest, most useful information.

Prioritize:

• visual impact
• immediate comprehension
• product recognition
• readability
• graphic clarity
• premium presentation

Use short labels and concise information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
24. FITNESS / NUTRITION VISUAL LANGUAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Communicate fitness through graphic clarity and visual energy rather than clichés.

Possible concepts:

• performance
• speed
• strength
• precision
• discipline
• energy
• wellness
• recovery
• athletic lifestyle
• modern sports culture

Flat Design should communicate these concepts through:

• color
• geometry
• typography
• composition
• scale
• direction
• rhythm

Do not automatically add gym equipment.

Do not automatically add athletes.

Do not use bodybuilding clichés unless explicitly requested.

The product itself should communicate the fitness or nutrition category whenever possible.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
25. NEGATIVE SPACE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Maintain deliberate negative space.

Flat Design depends on visual clarity.

Use empty space to:

• isolate the product
• strengthen hierarchy
• improve readability
• separate information
• create premium perception
• reduce visual fatigue

Do not fill empty areas with unnecessary shapes.

Empty space is an intentional design element.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
26. COMPOSITION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use professional Flat Design composition principles.

Possible approaches:

• centered hero
• asymmetric editorial layout
• bold geometric framing
• rule-of-thirds
• diagonal directional composition
• vertical product emphasis
• modular graphic layout
• strong color-block composition

Choose the strongest composition automatically based on the product image and extracted information.

Do not mechanically follow a template.

The composition must feel custom-designed for the specific product.

Maintain a consistent LTR visual flow.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
27. GRID AND ALIGNMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use an invisible professional grid.

Maintain:

• consistent margins
• consistent spacing
• precise alignment
• proportional relationships
• disciplined placement
• visual rhythm

Product, typography, logo, icons, and graphic shapes should feel connected through alignment.

Avoid randomly positioned elements.

Do not create excessive columns.

Keep the structure simple.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
28. BRANDING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If a brand name or logo is clearly visible on the product:

Integrate it subtly and professionally.

Do not overpower the product.

Do not redesign the logo.

Do not recreate a fake logo.

Do not invent brand elements.

Maintain visual consistency with the original packaging.

The brand should feel naturally integrated into the graphic system.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
29. PREMIUM COMMERCIAL QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The final advertisement should feel suitable for:

• premium sports nutrition brands
• luxury fitness brands
• modern wellness companies
• high-end supplement companies
• athletic lifestyle brands
• professional commercial campaigns
• premium social-media advertising

Think:

LUXURY FITNESS BRANDING

*

PREMIUM SPORTS NUTRITION

*

HIGH-END FLAT DESIGN

*

MODERN GRAPHIC COMMUNICATION

*

COMMERCIAL PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY

*

EDITORIAL ART DIRECTION

Do NOT make it look like:

• a generic AI poster
• a cheap supplement advertisement
• a children's infographic
• a cartoon poster
• a generic vector template
• a gaming poster
• a bodybuilding poster
• a crowded Instagram template
• a generic Canva design

The design should feel timeless, sophisticated, and commercially intentional.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
30. IMAGE QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Prioritize extremely high visual quality.

The final artwork must have:

• photorealistic product presentation
• accurate packaging
• sharp product details
• clean geometric graphics
• crisp edges
• precise typography
• accurate color relationships
• professional composition
• controlled visual hierarchy
• polished English typography
• premium art direction
• commercial-quality finish

Avoid:

• warped packaging
• distorted logos
• duplicated products
• malformed objects
• unreadable text
• inconsistent geometry
• sloppy alignment
• random colors
• excessive effects
• excessive gradients
• AI artifacts
• invented product information

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
31. FINAL ART-DIRECTION CHECK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before finalizing the artwork, evaluate it as a professional commercial Flat Design art director.

Ask:

Is the product immediately recognizable?

Is the product the strongest visual element?

Did the product analysis use only information actually visible in the uploaded image?

Are all nutritional values and specifications accurate?

Did the design avoid invented claims?

Is all newly generated text in natural, correct English?

Does the typography follow proper LTR composition?

Is the visual hierarchy immediately understandable?

Are the graphic shapes purposeful?

Are the colors controlled?

Is the composition too busy?

Are there unnecessary geometric elements?

Are there too many colors?

Are there too many icons?

Is there enough negative space?

Does the design feel genuinely Flat Design?

Does it look premium rather than generic?

Does the product feel premium?

Does the composition feel professionally art-directed?

Would a real premium fitness or nutrition brand publish this?

If removing an element makes the composition stronger, REMOVE IT.

The final design must feel:

CLEAN.
BOLD.
MODERN.
SIMPLE.
PREMIUM.
GRAPHIC.
CONFIDENT.
CRISP.
BALANCED.
INTENTIONAL.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.

The goal is NOT to demonstrate how many graphic shapes can be added.

The goal is to communicate the product with maximum visual clarity using the minimum number of necessary visual elements.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
32. FINAL OUTPUT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Generate ONE finished advertisement.

Do not generate multiple variations.

Do not show sketches.

Do not show wireframes.

Do not provide explanations.

Analyze the uploaded product image first.

Extract the reliable product information.

Select the most valuable information.

Determine the appropriate English copy.

Design the composition using the specified Flat Design art direction.

Then generate the final polished commercial artwork directly.

The final visible advertisement should be primarily English and follow a strict LTR visual structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
33. ASPECT RATIO — CHANGE ONLY THIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FINAL ASPECT RATIO:

9:16 VERTICAL PORTRAIT

Design the entire composition specifically for this aspect ratio from the beginning.

Do NOT create another aspect ratio and crop it afterward.

Do NOT stretch, squeeze, or distort the composition.

All visual elements must be intentionally positioned for the specified vertical format.

Maintain safe margins around the product, English typography, logo, icons, information blocks, and all important elements.

The final artwork must be a true 9:16 vertical composition optimized for Instagram Stories, Reels, and vertical social-media presentation.

prompts.title: Flat Design Ar
prompts.promptText:
Create a premium commercial FITNESS / NUTRITION advertisement using a STRICT, SOPHISTICATED, HIGH-END FLAT DESIGN STYLE.

The final artwork must be designed specifically for an ARABIC-SPEAKING AUDIENCE.

Arabic must be the PRIMARY visual language of the final advertisement.

The entire composition must follow a natural RIGHT-TO-LEFT (RTL) visual and typographic flow.

The final artwork must look like it was created by an elite commercial art director, premium fitness brand designer, professional product photographer, flat-design specialist, Arabic typography specialist, and high-end visual communication designer working together.

The result must feel:

CLEAN.
BOLD.
MODERN.
SIMPLE.
PREMIUM.
GRAPHIC.
CONFIDENT.
CRISP.
BALANCED.
INTENTIONAL.
COMMERCIAL.
ARABIC-FIRST.
EASY ON THE EYES.

This is NOT a generic "simple poster."

Do NOT simply remove shadows and place a product on a colored background.

Create a genuine, professionally art-directed Flat Design composition based on simplified geometry, bold visual hierarchy, clean shapes, controlled color, precise spacing, strong Arabic typography, visual clarity, and deliberate reduction of unnecessary detail.

The PRODUCT remains the HERO.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. PRODUCT INPUT
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRODUCT IMAGE:

[INSERT PRODUCT IMAGE]

The uploaded product image is the PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH.

The image must be analyzed before creating the advertisement.

Do NOT require the user to manually provide product information if it can be reliably extracted from the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. PRODUCT IMAGE ANALYSIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before designing the advertisement, carefully inspect the uploaded product image.

Identify and extract ONLY information that is clearly visible and reliably readable from the product packaging.

Analyze:

• اسم المنتج
• نوع المنتج
• اسم العلامة التجارية
• النكهة
• الوزن الصافي
• حجم الحصة
• كمية البروتين في الحصة
• السعرات الحرارية في الحصة
• نسبة البروتين
• الكربوهيدرات
• الدهون
• المكونات
• المعلومات الغذائية الأساسية
• خصائص المنتج
• ادعاءات المنتج
• الشهادات
• أي معلومات أخرى مطبوعة بوضوح على العبوة

The uploaded packaging is the authoritative source.

Do NOT invent, assume, estimate, infer, or fabricate product information.

If information is partially visible but cannot be read with confidence, DO NOT use it.

If information is completely absent from the image, DO NOT create it.

If nutritional information is visible, preserve the exact factual values and units shown on the packaging.

Do not convert, reinterpret, round, or modify numerical values unless explicitly requested.

For example:

If the package says:

"27g Protein"

the Arabic advertisement may present it as:

"27 غ بروتين"

If it says:

"109 kcal"

it may be presented as:

"109 سعرة حرارية"

If it says:

"1 KG"

it may be presented as:

"1 كغ"

The factual numerical value must remain unchanged.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. INFORMATION SELECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After analyzing the product image, automatically determine which extracted information is most valuable for a premium Flat Design commercial advertisement.

Prioritize:

1. اسم المنتج
2. اسم العلامة التجارية
3. أهم قيمة غذائية
4. أهم مواصفة للمنتج
5. الوزن الصافي
6. النكهة، إذا كانت مهمة
7. خاصية أو خاصيتان مهمتان للمنتج

Do NOT attempt to display every piece of information extracted from the packaging.

This is a PREMIUM ADVERTISEMENT, not a nutrition facts sheet.

Select only the information that improves the advertisement.

Use concise Arabic visual callouts instead of paragraphs.

For example, if clearly visible on the package:

27g Protein
109 kcal
86% Protein
1 KG

may be presented as:

27 غ بروتين
109 سعرة حرارية
86% بروتين
1 كغ

Only use these values if they are actually visible and readable in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. PRODUCT TITLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically determine the product title from the uploaded packaging.

Use the exact recognizable product name printed on the packaging whenever possible.

Do NOT invent a new product name.

Do NOT unnecessarily rewrite the brand or product name.

If the official product name is in English or another language, preserve the official product name when appropriate.

If a generic descriptive phrase can be naturally translated into Arabic without changing the product identity, translate it professionally.

Do NOT translate official brand names.

If the product title is unclear, use only the clearly readable portion.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. BRAND IDENTIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Automatically identify the brand from the packaging if clearly visible.

Preserve the original logo and brand identity.

Do NOT redesign the logo.

Do NOT recreate a fake logo.

Do NOT invent brand elements.

Do NOT translate the official brand name unless explicitly requested.

The brand should remain visually consistent with the original packaging.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6. PRODUCT PRESERVATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the provided product image as the PRIMARY VISUAL SOURCE.

The product is the central visual hero of the entire composition.

Do NOT unnecessarily redesign, deform, replace, recolor, or alter the product packaging.

Preserve:

• exact product shape
• packaging structure
• logo
• brand identity
• printed typography
• label details
• proportions
• colors
• recognizable characteristics
• material appearance

The product must remain immediately recognizable as the exact original product.

If the provided image contains multiple products, preserve the correct number of products.

Do not duplicate products unnecessarily.

Do not generate additional flavors, variants, containers, packages, or accessories unless they are visibly present in the uploaded image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7. TEXT GENERATION RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The advertisement may use TWO primary sources of text:

SOURCE A — USER-PROVIDED TEXT

If the user explicitly provides promotional text, CTA, price, offer, slogan, or campaign message, it may be incorporated into the design.

If the user-provided promotional text is in English but the final advertisement is intended for an Arabic-speaking audience, translate it naturally into professional Arabic unless the user explicitly requests English.

SOURCE B — PRODUCT-PACKAGING INFORMATION

The AI may extract factual product information directly from the uploaded packaging.

This includes clearly readable:

• اسم المنتج
• اسم العلامة التجارية
• القيم الغذائية
• مواصفات المنتج
• النكهة
• الوزن
• خصائص المنتج
• الادعاءات المطبوعة

ONLY use information that is clearly supported by the uploaded image or explicitly provided by the user.

All newly generated marketing text must be written in NATURAL, PROFESSIONAL, CORRECT ARABIC.

The copy must feel premium, concise, modern, and commercially appropriate.

Do NOT invent:

• nutritional facts
• ingredients
• calories
• protein percentages
• health claims
• medical claims
• prices
• discounts
• certifications
• awards
• statistics
• testimonials
• product specifications
• performance claims

Do not create marketing claims that are not supported by the packaging or user-provided information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
8. FACTUAL ACCURACY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This is CRITICAL.

Every factual product statement in the advertisement must be traceable to either:

1. The uploaded product packaging

OR

2. Information explicitly provided by the user.

Never fill missing information with assumptions.

Never use generic supplement statistics.

Never invent benefits simply because the product belongs to a particular category.

For example:

Do NOT automatically claim:

"يساعد على بناء العضلات"

"يحرق الدهون"

"يعزز هرمون التستوستيرون"

"يحسن الاستشفاء"

"مثبت سريريًا"

"نقي 100%"

"خالي من السكر"

"امتصاص سريع"

unless the claim is explicitly visible on the packaging or explicitly provided by the user.

Accuracy is more important than adding more text.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
9. LANGUAGE HANDLING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The FINAL ADVERTISEMENT must be ARABIC-FIRST.

All newly generated:

• headlines
• subtitles
• promotional messages
• CTAs
• supporting text
• product information callouts
• descriptive text

must be written in professional Arabic.

Use NATURAL MODERN ARABIC suitable for commercial fitness and nutrition advertising.

Use correct:

• spelling
• grammar
• punctuation
• Arabic typography
• RTL direction
• text hierarchy
• Arabic letter connections

Do NOT generate pseudo-Arabic text.

Do NOT generate meaningless Arabic-like text.

Do NOT reverse Arabic text.

Do NOT mirror Arabic letters incorrectly.

All Arabic text must read naturally from RIGHT TO LEFT.

The visual composition must also respect RTL reading flow.

The viewer's eye should naturally move through the design according to Arabic visual reading direction.

Do NOT introduce unnecessary bilingual text.

English should only remain when it is part of:

• the original product packaging
• the official brand identity
• the official product name
• a user-provided element that the user explicitly wants preserved

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
10. ARABIC FLAT-DESIGN COPY STYLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use short, sophisticated, premium Arabic advertising language.

The copy should feel:

• modern
• confident
• concise
• natural
• professional
• energetic
• performance-oriented

Avoid:

• cheap advertising language
• exaggerated claims
• long sentences
• unnecessary slogans
• excessive punctuation
• excessive exclamation marks
• generic motivational clichés

Prefer concise commercial Arabic.

Examples of STYLE only:

"أداء أقوى يبدأ من هنا"

"طاقة تدعم أداءك"

"اختيارك للأداء الأفضل"

"تدرّب. أدِّ. تعافَ."

"وقود لمستواك القادم"

These are examples of tone and structure only.

Do NOT automatically use these phrases unless they are appropriate to the specific product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
11. CORE FLAT-DESIGN DIRECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a sophisticated PREMIUM FLAT DESIGN visual system.

Flat Design must be treated as a deliberate visual communication system, not simply a design without shadows.

Use:

• simplified geometry
• clean vector-like shapes
• bold color blocks
• strong hierarchy
• crisp edges
• controlled proportions
• visual rhythm
• simple forms
• intentional negative space
• precise alignment
• restrained detail

The visual language should communicate maximum clarity with minimum visual complexity.

Use visual reduction intelligently.

Simplify supporting graphics while preserving the realism and recognizability of the actual product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
12. PRODUCT PRIORITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The product MUST remain more visually important than every graphic element.

The Flat Design system is the supporting visual language.

The product must remain:

• sharp
• recognizable
• readable
• visually dominant
• physically believable

Do NOT flatten or distort the actual product.

Do NOT turn the product packaging into a cartoon illustration.

Do NOT replace the product with a vector representation.

The real product image must remain the hero.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
13. VISUAL HIERARCHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Establish a strict visual hierarchy:

1. PRODUCT
2. ARABIC PRODUCT TITLE / PRIMARY MESSAGE
3. KEY PRODUCT INFORMATION
4. BRAND
5. SUPPORTING INFORMATION
6. CTA, if provided

The product must immediately attract attention.

Arabic typography must remain secondary to the product.

Graphic elements must remain supportive.

The viewer should understand the advertisement within approximately one second.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
14. GRAPHIC SHAPE SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use a controlled geometric language.

Possible shapes include:

• circles
• rounded rectangles
• capsules
• squares
• clean lines
• arcs
• simple curves
• geometric blocks
• minimal abstract forms

Use shapes to support:

• hierarchy
• direction
• framing
• information grouping
• product emphasis
• visual rhythm

Use the geometry to reinforce RTL composition.

Do NOT add random shapes merely to fill empty space.

Every shape must have a clear compositional purpose.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
15. COLOR BLOCKING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use strong, deliberate color blocking.

Build the palette around the actual product packaging and brand identity.

Prefer:

• one dominant background color
• product colors
• one supporting neutral
• one controlled accent color

Use bold areas of flat color where appropriate.

Colors should feel intentional rather than decorative.

Avoid:

• uncontrolled gradients
• rainbow palettes
• excessive color variety
• unrelated colors
• muddy color combinations

The product should remain the strongest source of visual identity.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16. BACKGROUND
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a clean, sophisticated Flat Design background.

Possible approaches:

• solid color
• two-tone composition
• simple geometric field
• restrained color blocks
• minimal abstract pattern
• clean editorial background

Choose the background according to the product and brand.

The background must remain visually quiet enough to support the product.

Avoid realistic environments unless explicitly requested.

Do NOT automatically create a gym scene.

Do NOT add random fitness equipment.

Do NOT use photographic backgrounds unless they genuinely support the Flat Design concept.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
17. PRODUCT PRESENTATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Treat the product as a premium commercial product-photography subject placed inside a Flat Design graphic environment.

Present it with:

• accurate scale
• realistic perspective
• clean positioning
• subtle grounding
• controlled visual separation

The product may be:

• centered
• slightly off-center
• aligned to a geometric grid
• positioned using the rule of thirds
• framed by simple graphic shapes

Choose the strongest placement automatically.

The actual product must remain realistic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
18. DEPTH AND SHADOW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Flat Design should use depth very sparingly.

If shadows are used, they must be:

• subtle
• clean
• controlled
• minimal
• purposeful

Prefer simple:

• contact shadows
• soft grounding shadows
• minimal offset shadows

Avoid:

• dramatic 3D shadows
• photorealistic environmental shadows
• excessive blur
• heavy drop shadows
• floating objects
• complex lighting effects

The design should remain visually flat while the product retains its natural photographic depth.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
19. ICONOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If icons are necessary, use a consistent minimalist icon system.

Icons should be:

• simple
• geometric
• clean
• immediately understandable
• visually consistent

Use icons only when they improve comprehension.

Possible applications:

• البروتين
• السعرات الحرارية
• الوزن
• حجم الحصة
• خصائص المنتج

Do NOT use decorative icons without purpose.

Do NOT use multiple unrelated icon styles.

Do NOT turn the advertisement into an infographic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
20. INFORMATION CALLOUTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When reliable nutritional or product information has been extracted from the packaging, present only the most important values as clean Flat Design information blocks.

Examples:

27 غ
بروتين

109
سعرة حرارية

86%
بروتين

1 كغ

These are ONLY examples of formatting.

Do not automatically use these numbers unless they are actually visible on the uploaded product packaging.

Information may be presented using:

• clean cards
• simple geometric containers
• circular information markers
• bold numeric blocks
• minimal dividers
• flat color panels

Keep them concise.

Do not create a dashboard.

Do not display too many numbers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
21. DISTRACTION CONTROL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THIS IS CRITICAL.

Flat Design can easily become overloaded with decorative shapes and colors.

Avoid that.

The advertisement must remain extremely easy on the eyes.

DO NOT add:

• random geometric shapes
• excessive circles
• excessive color blocks
• random lines
• unnecessary icons
• excessive patterns
• random gym equipment
• random dumbbells
• random weights
• bodybuilding silhouettes
• unrelated athletes
• random ingredients
• excessive gradients
• excessive shadows
• excessive outlines
• excessive typography
• fake statistics
• fake product claims
• fake certifications
• visual clutter

Do NOT create a generic vector poster.

Do NOT make every available space colorful.

If an element does not improve the product presentation, REMOVE IT.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
22. ARABIC TYPOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use premium modern Arabic typography.

Typography should be:

• bold
• clean
• highly readable
• modern
• confident
• geometric
• professionally balanced

Prefer professional Arabic sans-serif typography such as:

• Cairo
• IBM Plex Sans Arabic
• DIN Next Arabic style
• modern geometric Arabic sans-serif
• clean contemporary Arabic typography

Use no more than TWO typefaces.

Use typography as a major graphic element.

Possible treatments:

• عنوان عربي كبير
• أرقام غذائية بارزة
• معلومات مختصرة
• تسميات صغيرة
• كلمات رئيسية قوية
• عبارات قصيرة

All typography must follow RIGHT-TO-LEFT (RTL) direction.

Maintain proper:

• Arabic letter connections
• baseline alignment
• line spacing
• word spacing
• visual hierarchy
• RTL alignment

Do NOT use:

• decorative Arabic fonts
• childish fonts
• excessive calligraphy
• distorted typography
• reversed Arabic text
• glowing text
• metallic text
• excessive gradients
• excessive outlines
• excessive text effects

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
23. TEXT DENSITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Keep the amount of text LOW.

This is a premium commercial advertisement, NOT a product catalog, nutrition label, or flyer.

Do not copy the entire back label into the design.

Do not display every ingredient or nutritional value.

Select only the strongest, most useful information.

Prioritize:

• visual impact
• immediate comprehension
• product recognition
• readability
• graphic clarity
• premium presentation

Use short Arabic labels and concise information.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
24. FITNESS / NUTRITION VISUAL LANGUAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Communicate fitness through graphic clarity and visual energy rather than clichés.

Possible concepts:

• الأداء
• السرعة
• القوة
• الدقة
• الانضباط
• الطاقة
• العافية
• الاستشفاء
• نمط الحياة الرياضي
• الثقافة الرياضية الحديثة

Flat Design should communicate these concepts through:

• اللون
• الهندسة
• الخطوط
• التكوين
• الحجم
• الاتجاه
• الإيقاع البصري

Do not automatically add gym equipment.

Do not automatically add athletes.

Do not use bodybuilding clichés unless explicitly requested.

The product itself should communicate the fitness or nutrition category whenever possible.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
25. NEGATIVE SPACE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Maintain deliberate negative space.

Flat Design depends on visual clarity.

Use empty space to:

• isolate the product
• strengthen hierarchy
• improve readability
• separate information
• create premium perception
• reduce visual fatigue

Do not fill empty areas with unnecessary shapes.

Empty space is an intentional design element.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
26. COMPOSITION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use professional Flat Design composition principles.

Possible approaches:

• centered hero
• asymmetric editorial layout
• bold geometric framing
• rule-of-thirds
• diagonal directional composition
• vertical product emphasis
• modular graphic layout
• strong color-block composition

Choose the strongest composition automatically based on the product image and extracted information.

Do not mechanically follow a template.

The composition must feel custom-designed for the specific product.

Maintain a consistent RTL visual flow.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
27. GRID AND ALIGNMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use an invisible professional grid.

Maintain:

• consistent margins
• consistent spacing
• precise alignment
• proportional relationships
• disciplined placement
• visual rhythm

Product, Arabic typography, logo, icons, and graphic shapes should feel connected through alignment.

All major alignment decisions must respect the RTL reading direction.

Avoid randomly positioned elements.

Do not create excessive columns.

Keep the structure simple.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
28. BRANDING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If a brand name or logo is clearly visible on the product:

Integrate it subtly and professionally.

Do not overpower the product.

Do not redesign the logo.

Do not recreate a fake logo.

Do not invent brand elements.

Do not translate the official brand name unless explicitly requested.

Maintain visual consistency with the original packaging.

The brand should feel naturally integrated into the graphic system.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
29. PREMIUM COMMERCIAL QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The final advertisement should feel suitable for:

• premium sports nutrition brands
• luxury fitness brands
• modern wellness companies
• high-end supplement companies
• athletic lifestyle brands
• professional commercial campaigns
• premium Arabic social-media advertising

Think:

LUXURY FITNESS BRANDING

*

PREMIUM SPORTS NUTRITION

*

HIGH-END FLAT DESIGN

*

MODERN GRAPHIC COMMUNICATION

*

ARABIC COMMERCIAL ART DIRECTION

*

COMMERCIAL PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY

*

EDITORIAL ART DIRECTION

Do NOT make it look like:

• a generic AI poster
• a cheap supplement advertisement
• a children's infographic
• a cartoon poster
• a generic vector template
• a gaming poster
• a bodybuilding poster
• a crowded Instagram template
• a generic Canva design

The design should feel timeless, sophisticated, and commercially intentional.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
30. IMAGE QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Prioritize extremely high visual quality.

The final artwork must have:

• photorealistic product presentation
• accurate packaging
• sharp product details
• clean geometric graphics
• crisp edges
• precise Arabic typography
• accurate color relationships
• professional composition
• controlled visual hierarchy
• polished Arabic typography
• premium art direction
• commercial-quality finish

Avoid:

• warped packaging
• distorted logos
• duplicated products
• malformed objects
• unreadable Arabic text
• incorrect Arabic typography
• inconsistent geometry
• sloppy alignment
• random colors
• excessive effects
• excessive gradients
• AI artifacts
• invented product information

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
31. FINAL ART-DIRECTION CHECK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before finalizing the artwork, evaluate it as a professional Arabic commercial Flat Design art director.

Ask:

Is the product immediately recognizable?

Is the product the strongest visual element?

Did the product analysis use only information actually visible in the uploaded image?

Are all nutritional values and specifications accurate?

Did the design avoid invented claims?

Is all newly generated text in natural, correct Arabic?

Does the typography follow proper RTL composition?

Is the Arabic typography professionally typeset?

Is the visual hierarchy immediately understandable?

Are the graphic shapes purposeful?

Are the colors controlled?

Is the composition too busy?

Are there unnecessary geometric elements?

Are there too many colors?

Are there too many icons?

Is there enough negative space?

Does the design feel genuinely Flat Design?

Does it look premium rather than generic?

Does the product feel premium?

Does the composition feel professionally art-directed?

Would a real premium fitness or nutrition brand publish this?

If removing an element makes the composition stronger, REMOVE IT.

The final design must feel:

CLEAN.
BOLD.
MODERN.
SIMPLE.
PREMIUM.
GRAPHIC.
CONFIDENT.
CRISP.
BALANCED.
INTENTIONAL.
ARABIC-FIRST.
COMMERCIAL.
EASY ON THE EYES.
